      define(genFun, toStringTagSymbol, "GeneratorFunction");
    }
    genFun.prototype = Object.create(Gp);
    return genFun;
  };

  // Within the body of any async function, `await x` is transformed to
  // `yield regeneratorRuntime.awrap(x)`, so that the runtime can test
  // `hasOwn.call(value, "__await")` to determine if the yielded value is
  // meant to be awaited.
  exports.awrap = function(arg) {
    return { __await: arg };
  };

  function AsyncIterator(generator, PromiseImpl) {
    function invoke(method, arg, resolve, reject) {
      var record = tryCatch(generator[method], generator, arg);
      if (record.type === "throw") {
        reject(record.arg);
      } else {
        var result = record.arg;
        var value = result.value;
        if (value &&
            typeof value === "object" &&
            hasOwn.call(value, "__await")) {
          return PromiseImpl.resolve(value.__await).then(function(value) {
            invoke("next", value, resolve, reject);
          }, function(err) {
            invoke("throw", err, resolve, reject);
          });
        }

        return PromiseImpl.resolve(value).then(function(unwrapped) {
          // When a yielded Promise is resolved, its final value becomes
          // the .value of the Promise<{value,done}> result for the
          // current iteration.
          result.value = unwrapped;
          resolve(result);
        }, function(error) {
          // If a rejected Promise was yielded, throw the rejection back
          // into the async generator function so it can be handled there.
          return invoke("throw", error, resolve, reject);
        });
      }
    }

    var previousPromise;

    function enqueue(method, arg) {
      function callInvokeWithMethodAndArg() {
        return new PromiseImpl(function(resolve, reject) {
          invoke(method, arg, resolve, reject);
        });
      }

      return previousPromise =
        // If enqueue has been called before, then we want to wait until
        // all previous Promises have been resolved before calling invoke,
        // so that results are always delivered in the correct order. If
        // enqueue has not been called before, then it is important to
        // call invoke immediately, without waiting on a callback to fire,
        // so that the async generator function has the opportunity to do
        // any necessary setup in a predictable way. This predictability
        // is why the Promise constructor synchronously invokes its
        // executor callback, and why async functions synchronously
        // execute code before the first await. Since we implement simple
        // async functions in terms of async generators, it is especially
        // important to get this right, even though it requires care.
        previousPromise ? previousPromise.then(
          callInvokeWithMethodAndArg,
          // Avoid propagating failures to Promises returned by later
          // invocations of the iterator.
          callInvokeWithMethodAndArg
        ) : callInvokeWithMethodAndArg();
    }

    // Define the unified helper method that is used to implement .next,
    // .throw, and .return (see defineIteratorMethods).
    this._invoke = enqueue;
  }

  defineIteratorMethods(AsyncIterator.prototype);
  AsyncIterator.prototype[asyncIteratorSymbol] = function () {
    return this;
  };
  exports.AsyncIterator = AsyncIterator;

  // Note that simple async functions are implemented on top of
  // AsyncIterator objects; they just return a Promise for the value of
  // the final result produced by the iterator.
  exports.async = function(innerFn, outerFn, self, tryLocsList, PromiseImpl) {
    if (PromiseImpl === void 0) PromiseImpl = Promise;

    var iter = new AsyncIterator(
      wrap(innerFn, outerFn, self, tryLocsList),
      PromiseImpl
    );

    return exports.isGeneratorFunction(outerFn)
      ? iter // If outerFn is a generator, return the full iterator.
      : iter.next().then(function(result) {
          return result.done ? result.value : iter.next();
        });
  };

  function makeInvokeMethod(innerFn, self, context) {
    var state = GenStateSuspendedStart;

    return function invoke(method, arg) {
      if (state === GenStateExecuting) {
        throw new Error("Generator is already running");
      }

      if (state === GenStateCompleted) {
        if (method === "throw") {
          throw arg;
        }

        // Be forgiving, per 25.3.3.3.3 of the spec:
        // https://people.mozilla.org/~jorendorff/es6-draft.html#sec-generatorresume
        return doneResult();
      }

      context.method = method;
      context.arg = arg;

      while (true) {
        var delegate = context.delegate;
        if (delegate) {
          var delegateResult = maybeInvokeDelegate(delegate, context);
          if (delegateResult) {
            if (delegateResult === ContinueSentinel) continue;
            return delegateResult;
          }
        }

        if (context.method === "next") {
          // Setting context._sent for legacy support of Babel's
          // function.sent implementation.
          context.sent = context._sent = context.arg;

        } else if (context.method === "throw") {
          if (state === GenStateSuspendedStart) {
            state = GenStateCompleted;
            throw context.arg;
          }

          context.dispatchException(context.arg);

        } else if (context.method === "return") {
          context.abrupt("return", context.arg);
        }

        state = GenStateExecuting;

        var record = tryCatch(innerFn, self, context);
        if (record.type === "normal") {
          // If an exception is thrown from innerFn, we leave state ===
          // GenStateExecuting and loop back for another invocation.
          state = context.done
            ? GenStateCompleted
            : GenStateSuspendedYield;

          if (record.arg === ContinueSentinel) {
            continue;
          }

          return {
            value: record.arg,
            done: context.done
          };

        } else if (record.type === "throw") {
          state = GenStateCompleted;
          // Dispatch the exception by looping back around to the
          // context.dispatchException(context.arg) call above.
          context.method = "throw";
          context.arg = record.arg;
        }
      }
    };
  }

  // Call delegate.iterator[context.method](context.arg) and handle the
  // result, either by returning a { value, done } result from the
  // delegate iterator, or by modifying context.method and context.arg,
  // setting context.delegate to null, and returning the ContinueSentinel.
  function maybeInvokeDelegate(delegate, context) {
    var method = delegate.iterator[context.method];
    if (method === undefined) {
      // A .throw or .return when the delegate iterator has no .throw
      // method always terminates the yield* loop.
      context.delegate = null;

      if (context.method === "throw") {
        // Note: ["return"] must be used for ES3 parsing compatibility.
        if (delegate.iterator["return"]) {
          // If the delegate iterator has a return method, give it a
          // chance to clean up.
          context.method = "return";
          context.arg = undefined;
          maybeInvokeDelegate(delegate, context);

          if (context.method === "throw") {
            // If maybeInvokeDelegate(context) changed context.method from
            // "return" to "throw", let that override the TypeError below.
            return ContinueSentinel;
          }
        }

        context.method = "throw";
        context.arg = new TypeError(
          "The iterator does not provide a 'throw' method");
      }

      return ContinueSentinel;
    }

    var record = tryCatch(method, delegate.iterator, context.arg);

    if (record.type === "throw") {
      context.method = "throw";
      context.arg = record.arg;
      context.delegate = null;
      return ContinueSentinel;
    }

    var info = record.arg;

    if (! info) {
      context.method = "throw";
      context.arg = new TypeError("iterator result is not an object");
      context.delegate = null;
      return ContinueSentinel;
    }

    if (info.done) {
      // Assign the result of the finished delegate to the temporary
      // variable specified by delegate.resultName (see delegateYield).
      context[delegate.resultName] = info.value;

      // Resume execution at the desired location (see delegateYield).
      context.next = delegate.nextLoc;

      // If context.method was "throw" but the delegate handled the
      // exception, let the outer generator proceed normally. If
      // context.method was "next", forget context.arg since it has been
      // "consumed" by the delegate iterator. If context.method was
      // "return", allow the original .return call to continue in the
      // outer generator.
      if (context.method !== "return") {
        context.method = "next";
        context.arg = undefined;
      }

    } else {
      // Re-yield the result returned by the delegate method.
      return info;
    }

    // The delegate iterator is finished, so forget it and continue with
    // the outer generator.
    context.delegate = null;
    return ContinueSentinel;
  }

  // Define Generator.prototype.{next,throw,return} in terms of the
  // unified ._invoke helper method.
  defineIteratorMethods(Gp);

  define(Gp, toStringTagSymbol, "Generator");

  // A Generator should always return itself as the iterator object when the
  // @@iterator function is called on it. Some browsers' implementations of the
  // iterator prototype chain incorrectly implement this, causing the Generator
  // object to not be returned from this call. This ensures that doesn't happen.
  // See https://github.com/facebook/regenerator/issues/274 for more details.
  Gp[iteratorSymbol] = function() {
    return this;
  };

  Gp.toString = function() {
    return "[object Generator]";
  };

  function pushTryEntry(locs) {
    var entry = { tryLoc: locs[0] };

    if (1 in locs) {
      entry.catchLoc = locs[1];
    }

    if (2 in locs) {
      entry.finallyLoc = locs[2];
      entry.afterLoc = locs[3];
    }

    this.tryEntries.push(entry);
  }

  function resetTryEntry(entry) {
    var record = entry.completion || {};
    record.type = "normal";
    delete record.arg;
    entry.completion = record;
  }

  function Context(tryLocsList) {
    // The root entry object (effectively a try statement without a catch
    // or a finally block) gives us a place to store values thrown from
    // locations where there is no enclosing try statement.
    this.tryEntries = [{ tryLoc: "root" }];
    tryLocsList.forEach(pushTryEntry, this);
    this.reset(true);
  }

  exports.keys = function(object) {
    var keys = [];
    for (var key in object) {
      keys.push(key);
    }
    keys.reverse();

    // Rather than returning an object with a next method, we keep
    // things simple and return the next function itself.
    return function next() {
      while (keys.length) {
        var key = keys.pop();
        if (key in object) {
          next.value = key;
          next.done = false;
          return next;
        }
      }

      // To avoid creating an additional object, we just hang the .value
      // and .done properties off the next function object itself. This
      // also ensures that the minifier will not anonymize the function.
      next.done = true;
      return next;
    };
  };

  function values(iterable) {
    if (iterable) {
      var iteratorMethod = iterable[iteratorSymbol];
      if (iteratorMethod) {
        return iteratorMethod.call(iterable);
      }

      if (typeof iterable.next === "function") {
        return iterable;
      }

      if (!isNaN(iterable.length)) {
        var i = -1, next = function next() {
          while (++i < iterable.length) {
            if (hasOwn.call(iterable, i)) {
              next.value = iterable[i];
              next.done = false;
              return next;
            }
          }

          next.value = undefined;
          next.done = true;

          return next;
        };

        return next.next = next;
      }
    }

    // Return an iterator with no values.
    return { next: doneResult };
  }
  exports.values = values;

  function doneResult() {
    return { value: undefined, done: true };
  }

  Context.prototype = {
    constructor: Context,

    reset: function(skipTempReset) {
      this.prev = 0;
      this.next = 0;
      // Resetting context._sent for legacy support of Babel's
      // function.sent implementation.
      this.sent = this._sent = undefined;
      this.done = false;
      this.delegate = null;

      this.method = "next";
      this.arg = undefined;

      this.tryEntries.forEach(resetTryEntry);

      if (!skipTempReset) {
        for (var name in this) {
          // Not sure about the optimal order of these conditions:
          if (name.charAt(0) === "t" &&
              hasOwn.call(this, name) &&
              !isNaN(+name.slice(1))) {
            this[name] = undefined;
          }
        }
      }
    },

    stop: function() {
      this.done = true;

      var rootEntry = this.tryEntries[0];
      var rootRecord = rootEntry.completion;
      if (rootRecord.type === "throw") {
        throw rootRecord.arg;
      }

      return this.rval;
    },

    dispatchException: function(exception) {
      if (this.done) {
        throw exception;
      }

      var context = this;
      function handle(loc, caught) {
        record.type = "throw";
        record.arg = exception;
        context.next = loc;

        if (caught) {
          // If the dispatched exception was caught by a catch block,
          // then let that catch block handle the exception normally.
          context.method = "next";
          context.arg = undefined;
        }

        return !! caught;
      }

      for (var i = this.tryEntries.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        var entry = this.tryEntries[i];
        var record = entry.completion;

        if (entry.tryLoc === "root") {
          // Exception thrown outside of any try block that could handle
          // it, so set the completion value of the entire function to
          // throw the exception.
          return handle("end");
        }

        if (entry.tryLoc <= this.prev) {
          var hasCatch = hasOwn.call(entry, "catchLoc");
          var hasFinally = hasOwn.call(entry, "finallyLoc");

          if (hasCatch && hasFinally) {
            if (this.prev < entry.catchLoc) {
              return handle(entry.catchLoc, true);
            } else if (this.prev < entry.finallyLoc) {
              return handle(entry.finallyLoc);
            }

          } else if (hasCatch) {
            if (this.prev < entry.catchLoc) {
              return handle(entry.catchLoc, true);
            }

          } else if (hasFinally) {
            if (this.prev < entry.finallyLoc) {
              return handle(entry.finallyLoc);
            }

          } else {
            throw new Error("try statement without catch or finally");
          }
        }
      }
    },

    abrupt: function(type, arg) {
      for (var i = this.tryEntries.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        var entry = this.tryEntries[i];
        if (entry.tryLoc <= this.prev &&
            hasOwn.call(entry, "finallyLoc") &&
            this.prev < entry.finallyLoc) {
          var finallyEntry = entry;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (finallyEntry &&
          (type === "break" ||
           type === "continue") &&
          finallyEntry.tryLoc <= arg &&
          arg <= finallyEntry.finallyLoc) {
        // Ignore the finally entry if control is not jumping to a
        // location outside the try/catch block.
        finallyEntry = null;
      }

      var record = finallyEntry ? finallyEntry.completion : {};
      record.type = type;
      record.arg = arg;

      if (finallyEntry) {
        this.method = "next";
        this.next = finallyEntry.finallyLoc;
        return ContinueSentinel;
      }

      return this.complete(record);
    },

    complete: function(record, afterLoc) {
      if (record.type === "throw") {
        throw record.arg;
      }

      if (record.type === "break" ||
          record.type === "continue") {
        this.next = record.arg;
      } else if (record.type === "return") {
        this.rval = this.arg = record.arg;
        this.method = "return";
        this.next = "end";
      } else if (record.type === "normal" && afterLoc) {
        this.next = afterLoc;
      }

      return ContinueSentinel;
    },

    finish: function(finallyLoc) {
      for (var i = this.tryEntries.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        var entry = this.tryEntries[i];
        if (entry.finallyLoc === finallyLoc) {
          this.complete(entry.completion, entry.afterLoc);
          resetTryEntry(entry);
          return ContinueSentinel;
        }
      }
    },

    "catch": function(tryLoc) {
      for (var i = this.tryEntries.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        var entry = this.tryEntries[i];
        if (entry.tryLoc === tryLoc) {
          var record = entry.completion;
          if (record.type === "throw") {
            var thrown = record.arg;
            resetTryEntry(entry);
          }
          return thrown;
        }
      }

      // The context.catch method must only be called with a location
      // argument that corresponds to a known catch block.
      throw new Error("illegal catch attempt");
    },

    delegateYield: function(iterable, resultName, nextLoc) {
      this.delegate = {
        iterator: values(iterable),
        resultName: resultName,
        nextLoc: nextLoc
      };

      if (this.method === "next") {
        // Deliberately forget the last sent value so that we don't
        // accidentally pass it on to the delegate.
        this.arg = undefined;
      }

      return ContinueSentinel;
    }
  };

  // Regardless of whether this script is executing as a CommonJS module
  // or not, return the runtime object so that we can declare the variable
  // regeneratorRuntime in the outer scope, which allows this module to be
  // injected easily by `bin/regenerator --include-runtime script.js`.
  return exports;

}(
  // If this script is executing as a CommonJS module, use module.exports
  // as the regeneratorRuntime namespace. Otherwise create a new empty
  // object. Either way, the resulting object will be used to initialize
  // the regeneratorRuntime variable at the top of this file.
   true ? module.exports : undefined
));

try {
  regeneratorRuntime = runtime;
} catch (accidentalStrictMode) {
  // This module should not be running in strict mode, so the above
  // assignment should always work unless something is misconfigured. Just
  // in case runtime.js accidentally runs in strict mode, we can escape
  // strict mode using a global Function call. This could conceivably fail
  // if a Content Security Policy forbids using Function, but in that case
  // the proper solution is to fix the accidental strict mode problem. If
  // you've misconfigured your bundler to force strict mode and applied a
  // CSP to forbid Function, and you're not willing to fix either of those
  // problems, please detail your unique predicament in a GitHub issue.
  Function("r", "regeneratorRuntime = r")(runtime);
}

  /**
   * URLチェック

  function analyzeUrl() {
    var locationPathItemList = location.pathname.split('/'); // 開催場

    if (typeof _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[4]] !== 'undefined') {
      place = locationPathItemList[4];
      placeCode = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[4]];
    } else {
      $('#ai-race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
      urlError = true;
    }

    var raceDateNo = locationPathItemList[5].split('_'); // 開催日

    if (checkDate(raceDateNo[0])) {
      raceDate = new Date(raceDateNo[0]);
    } else {
      $('#ai-race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
      urlError = true;
    } // レース番号


    if (!raceDateNo[1]) {
      // レース番号の指定がない場合は1Rを表示
      raceNo = 1;
    } else {
      // レース番号指定
      if (checkRaceno(raceDateNo[1])) {
        raceNo = parseInt(raceDateNo[1]);
      } else {
        $('#ai-race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
        urlError = true;
      }
    }
  }

  function renderRaceInfo() {

    var reqDate = generateReqDate(raceDate);

      'placeCode': placeCode,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': raceNo
    };
    var url = '/race_info/OtherRaceInfo';
    axios.post(url, params).then(function (orgRes) {
      var res = orgRes.data.body;
      renderRaceInfoByRes(res, refundFlg);
      _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].showRaceLink(res.finalRaceNo);
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
        // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
        tokenErrorCount++;
        setTimeout(function () {
          renderRaceInfo(refundFlg, tokenErrorCount);
        }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.interval);
      } else {
        // 予期せぬエラー
        console.log(error); // 天候、気温、湿度、走路温度をマスク

        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) > tbody > td:nth-child(4)').text('-');

        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) > tbody > td:nth-child(3)').text('-');

      }
    });
  }

  function createUrl() {

  /**
   * 日付文字列の妥当性チェック
   *
   * @param string strDate 日付文字列
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function checkDate(strDate) {
    if (strDate.match(/^\d{4}\-\d{2}\-\d{2}$/) == null) {
      return false;
    }

    var y = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[0]);
    var m = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[1]) - 1;
    var d = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[2]);
    var date = new Date(y, m, d);

    if (date.getFullYear() != y || date.getMonth() != m || date.getDate() != d) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**
   * レース番号の妥当性チェック
   *
   * @param string strRaceno レース番号文字列
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function checkRaceno(strRaceno) {
    if (strRaceno.match(/^\d{1,2}$/) == null) {
      return false;
    }

    if (parseInt(strRaceno) < 1 || parseInt(strRaceno) > 12) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**
   * ブラウザバック用の履歴作成
   */


  function makeHistory() {
    window.history.pushState(null, "", createUrl());
  }
  /**
   * APIリクエスト用の日付文字列を生成
   *
   * @param Date date 日付インスタンス
   * @returns {string} 日付文字列
   */


  function generateReqDate(date) {
    return date.getFullYear() + '-' + ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
  }

  function searchAddress() {
    var url = '/address';
    var zipVal = $('#allstar_zip').val(); // 余計なハイフン削除

    var zipCode = replaceHyphen(zipVal); // console.log(zipCode)

      // console.log(orgRes)
      $('#allstar_zip_notice').text('').hide();
      $('#allstar_zip_notice_parent').removeClass('contactItem--required');

      if (orgRes.data.result === 'Failure') {
        orgRes.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示
          appendNotice(value.code);
        });
      } else {
        var res = orgRes.data.body;
        $('#allstar_pref option[value=' + res.prefectureId + ']').prop('selected', true);
        $('#allstar_city').val(res.city);
        $('#allstar_address1').val(res.address1);
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
    });
    return true;

  function validationRequest() {

    var params = makeParams(true); // リクエスト

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      resetNotice(); // console.log(res.data)

      if (res.data.result === 'Failure') {
        // バリデーションエラー
        res.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示
          appendNotice(value.code);
        });
      } else {
        // 確認画面に切り替え
        displayConfirm();
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
    });
    return true;
  }

$(function () {
  var btnDisabled = true; // ボタン状態（true:非活性, false:活性）

  if ($('#agree-privacy').length) {
    // 同意チェックがある場合はエントリーボタンを非活性化
    entryBtnStateChange(); // 同意チェックボックス

    $('#agree-privacy').on('change', function (e) {
      btnDisabled = $(this).is(':checked') ? false : true;
      entryBtnStateChange();
    });
  }
  /**
   * エントリーボタン状態変更
   */


  function entryBtnStateChange() {
    var disabledClass = 'bg-light text-secondary'; // 非活性時に付与するクラス

    var button = $('#campaign-form-entry-btn'); // 対象のDOM

    if (btnDisabled) {
      button.addClass(disabledClass);
    } else {
      button.removeClass(disabledClass);
    }

    button.prop('disabled', btnDisabled);
  }
});

   * バリデーションリクエスト
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗

  function validationRequest() {
    // パラメータセット
    var params = makeParams(true); // リクエスト

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      resetNotice();

      if (res.data.result === 'Failure') {
        // バリデーションエラー
        res.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示

        });

        // 確認画面に切り替え

      console.log(error);
    });
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 送信リクエスト
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function submitRequest() {
    // パラメータセット
    var params = makeParams(false); // リクエスト

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      resetNotice();

      if (res.data.result === 'Failure') {
        // バリデーションエラー(基本起こり得ないが、入力画面に戻す)
        res.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示
          appendNotice(value.code);
          displayInput();
        });
      } else {
        // 完了画面に切り替え
        displayThanks();
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_error').text('システムエラーが発生しました。').show();
      console.log(error);
    });

   * バリデーションエラー文言のリセット

   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗

    $('p.contactItem__message').text('').hide();
    $('div.contactItem--required').removeClass('contactItem--required');
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * バリデーションエラー文言の表示
   *
   * @param {string} code エラーコード

  function appendNotice(code) {
    var dom = $('#' + errors[code].notice_id); // メッセージの挿入

    dom.text(errors[code].message).show();
    dom.parent().addClass('contactItem--required');
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 確認画面の表示
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function displayConfirm() {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    inputIdPrefixes.forEach(function (id) {
      var dom = $('#' + id);
      var val = dom.val();

      if (dom.prop('tagName') === 'SELECT') {
        // selectタグの場合は値ではなく表示名
        val = $('#' + id + ' option:selected').text();
      }

      dom.hide();
      $('#' + id + '_confirm').text(val).show();
    });
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_confirm_btns').hide();
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_submit_btns').show();
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 入力画面の表示
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function displayInput() {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    inputIdPrefixes.forEach(function (id) {
      $('#' + id).show();
      $('#' + id + '_confirm').hide();
    });
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_confirm_btns').show();
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_submit_btns').hide();
    return true;

   * 完了画面の表示
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗

  function displayThanks() {

      $('#' + id + '_confirm').show();

    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_thanks').show();
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_msg').hide();
    $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_form').hide();
    return true;

   * @param {boolean} $valudationOnly バリデーションのみ処理フラグ
   * @returns {object} パラメータ
   */


  function makeParams(valudationOnly) {
    var params = {
      userNumber: $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_user_number').val(),
      name: $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_name').val(),
      email: $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_email').val(),
      phoneNumber: $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_phone_number').val(),
      companion: $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_companion').val(),
      validationOnly: valudationOnly
    };
    return params;
  }
  /**
   * フォーム初期値自動入力
   */


  function renderInputInitial() {
    var domain = document.domain;
    var url = '';

    if (domain == 'autorace.jp') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.jp/api/offcl/me';
    } else if (domain == 'autorace.click') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.click/api/offcl/me';
    } else if (domain == 'autorace.club') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.club/api/offcl/me';
    } else {
      url = '/api/offcl/me';
    }

    var params = {
      withCredentials: true
    };
    axios.get(url, params).then(function (jsonData) {
      // ログイン後
      var name = jsonData.data.last_name + '　' + jsonData.data.first_name;
      $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_user_number').val(jsonData.data.user_number);
      $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_name').val(name);
      $('#visit_kawaguchi_cpn_email').val(jsonData.data.email);
    })["catch"](function (error) {// ログイン前・ログイン情報の取得エラー時は何も行わない
    });
  }
});

$(function () {
  // メール入力必須賞品のIDリスト
  var mailInputItem = ['3', '6', '7'];

  if (location.pathname.match(/^\/campaign\/thanksgiving\/2025/) != null) {
    // 初期処理
    switchPrizeItem($('input.course-input:checked').val());
    switchInputMail($('input.prize-input:checked').val()); // コース選択

    $('.course-input').on('change', function (e) {
      switchPrizeItem($(this).val());
      switchInputMail();
    }); // 賞品選択

    $(document).on('change', '.prize-input', function (e) {
      switchInputMail($(this).val());
    }); // プライバシーポリシー同意ボタン

    $('#agree-privacy').on('change', function (e) {
      var disabled = true;
      var activeClass = 'text-white';
      var disabledClass = 'bg-light text-secondary';

      if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
        disabled = false;
        $('#entry-btn').addClass(activeClass).removeClass(disabledClass);
      } else {
        $('#entry-btn').addClass(disabledClass).removeClass(activeClass);
      }

      $('#entry-btn').prop('disabled', disabled);
    });
  }
  /**
   * 選択コースに応じて賞品を出し分け
   * 
   * @param string couse 
   */


  function switchPrizeItem(couse) {
    var prizeItem = $($('#template_prize-item-' + couse).clone().html());
    $('#prize-area').html(prizeItem);
  }
  /**
   * 選択賞品に応じてメール入力欄を出し分け
   * 
   * @param string item 
   */


  function switchInputMail() {
    var item = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : 0;
    $('#email-section').removeClass('is-hidden');

    if (mailInputItem.includes(item) === false) {
      $('#email-section').addClass('is-hidden');
    }
  }
});

   */


  function makeParams(valudationOnly) {
    var zipCode = '';

    if ($('#transfer_cpn_zip_1').val() !== '' || $('#transfer_cpn_zip_2').val() !== '') {
      zipCode = $('#transfer_cpn_zip_1').val() + $('#transfer_cpn_zip_2').val();

  function renderInputInitial() {
    var domain = document.domain;
    var url = '';

    if (domain == 'autorace.jp') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.jp/api/offcl/me';
    } else if (domain == 'autorace.click') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.click/api/offcl/me';
    } else if (domain == 'autorace.club') {
      url = 'https://api.autorace.club/api/offcl/me';
    } else {
      url = '/api/offcl/me';

      withCredentials: true

    });

   * @returns {boolean}

  function searchAddress() {
    if ($('#transfer_cpn_zip_1').val() == '' || $('#transfer_cpn_zip_2').val() == '') {
      return;

    var param = {
      zipCode: $('#transfer_cpn_zip_1').val() + $('#transfer_cpn_zip_2').val()

        $('#transfer_cpn_address').val(res.city + res.address1);
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
    });
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * 住所検索APIリクエスト

  function searchAddress() {
    var url = '/address';
    var zipVal = $('#character_campaign_zip').val(); // 余計なハイフン削除

    var zipCode = replaceHyphen(zipVal);
    var param = {
      zipCode: zipCode
    };
    axios.post(url, param).then(function (orgRes) {
      $('#character_campaign_zip_notice').text('').hide();
      $('#character_campaign_zip_notice_parent').removeClass('contactItem--required');

      if (orgRes.data.result === 'Failure') {
        orgRes.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示
          appendNotice(value.code);
        });
      } else {
        var res = orgRes.data.body;
        $('#character_campaign_pref option[value=' + res.prefectureId + ']').prop('selected', true);
        $('#character_campaign_city').val(res.city);
        $('#character_campaign_address1').val(res.address1);
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
    });
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * バリデーションリクエスト
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function validationRequest() {
    var url = '/CharacterCampaign/api'; // パラメータセット

    var params = makeParams(true); // リクエスト

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      resetNotice();

      if (res.data.result === 'Failure') {
        // バリデーションエラー
        res.data.errors.forEach(function (value, index) {
          // エラー文言を表示
          appendNotice(value.code);
        });
      } else {
        // 確認画面に切り替え
        displayConfirm();
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
      appendNotice(9999);
    });
    return true;
  }

  function submitRequest() {
    var url = '/CharacterCampaign/api'; // パラメータセット

    var params = makeParams(false); // リクエスト

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      resetNotice();

      } else {
        // 完了画面に遷移
        redirectThanks();
      }

      console.log(error);
      appendNotice(9999);
    });
    return true;
  }

    $('#' + errors[code].notice_id + '_parent').addClass('contactItem--required');

  /**

  function displayConfirm() {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    inputIdPrefixes.forEach(function (id) {
      var dom = $('#' + id);
      var val = dom.val(); // ラジオボタンの場合（name属性で判定）

      if ($('input[name="' + id + '"]:checked').length > 0) {
        val = $('input[name="' + id + '"]:checked').text();
        var selected = $('input[name="' + id + '"]:checked');
        val = $('label[for="' + selected.attr('id') + '"]').text();
        $('.' + id + '_parent').removeClass('d-flex align-items-center').hide();
      } else if (dom.prop('tagName') === 'SELECT' && $('#' + id + ' option:selected').val() !== '') {
        // selectタグの場合は値ではなく表示名
        val = $('#' + id + ' option:selected').text();
      }

      $('#' + id).css('cssText', 'display: none !important');
      $('#' + id + '_notice_parent span').css('cssText', 'display: none !important');
      $('#' + id + '_confirm').text(val).show();
    });
    $('#subtitle_input').hide();
    $('#subtitle_confirm').show();
    $('.required_content').removeClass('contactItem__label--required');
    $('#privacy_text_link').hide();
    $('#note_message').hide();
    $('#character_campaign_confirm_btn').hide();
    $('#character_campaign_submit_btn').show();
    $('#character_campaign_back_btn').show();
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 入力画面の表示
   *
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗

  function displayInput() {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);

    $('#character_campaign_submit_btn').hide();
    $('#character_campaign_back_btn').hide();
    return true;

  /**
   * 完了画面に遷移

   */


  function redirectThanks() {
    var character_id = $('#character_campaign_character_id').val(); // リダイレクトする

    location.href = '/news/campaign/2025/sousenkyo/thanks/th' + String(character_id).padStart(2, '0') + '.html';
  }
  /**
   * APIリクエスト用パラメータ作成
   *
   * @param {boolean} $validationOnly バリデーションのみ処理フラグ
   * @returns {object} パラメータ
   */


  function makeParams(validationOnly) {
    // 余計なハイフンを削除
    var tel = $('#character_campaign_tel').val();

    if (tel !== '') {
      tel = replaceHyphen(tel);
    }

    var zip = $('#character_campaign_zip').val();

    if (zip !== '') {
      zip = replaceHyphen(zip);
    }

    var params = {
      characterId: $('#character_campaign_character_id').val(),
      entry: $('input[name="character_campaign_entry"]:checked').val(),
      name: $('#character_campaign_name').val(),
      kana: $('#character_campaign_kana').val(),
      zip: zip,
      prefectureId: $('#character_campaign_pref option:selected').val(),
      city: $('#character_campaign_city').val(),
      address1: $('#character_campaign_address1').val(),
      address2: $('#character_campaign_address2').val(),
      tel: tel,
      email: $('#character_campaign_email').val(),
      userNumber: $('#character_campaign_user_number').val(),
      validationOnly: validationOnly,
      privacyAgree: $('#character_campaign_privacy_agree').prop("checked")
    };
    return params;
  }
  /**
   * 余計なハイフン削除
   *
   * @param {string} str
   * @returns {string} 変換後文字列
   */


  function replaceHyphen(str) {
    return str.replace(/-/g, '');
  }

/**
 * 本日開催の競技場にアイコン表示
 *
 * @param {object} holdToday 本日の開催情報
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
var renderPlacePlayIcon = function renderPlacePlayIcon() {
  var holdToday = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : null;

  if (holdToday == null) {
    axios.get('/race_info/XML/Hold/Today').then(function (orgRes) {
      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
        return;
      }

      orgRes.data.body.today.forEach(function (t) {
        showPlayIcon(t);
      });
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
      return;
    });
  } else {
    showPlayIcon(holdToday);
  }

  return true;
};
/**
 * 開催中アイコン表示処理

function showPlayIcon(holdToday) {
  var todayPlayItem = $($('#template_header-play-icon').clone().html());
  $('li[data-circuit="' + holdToday.placeKey + '"] > a > span').html(todayPlayItem);

/**
 * imgのsrc属性の更新（Safari対応）
 *
 * @param {object} target 対象img DOM
 * @param {string} src 画像URL
 *
 * @returns {boolean}
 */


function updateImgSrc(target, src) {
  if (getClientBrowser() === 'Safari') {
    target.get(0).src = src;
  } else {
    target.attr('src', src);
  }

  return true;
}
/**
 * アクセス元ブラウザの種類を判別、取得する
 *
 * @returns {string} ブラウザ名
 */


function getClientBrowser() {
  var userAgent = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();

  if (userAgent.indexOf('msie') != -1 || userAgent.indexOf('trident') != -1) {
    return 'IE';
  } else if (userAgent.indexOf('edge') != -1) {
    return 'Edge';
  } else if (userAgent.indexOf('chrome') != -1) {
    return 'Chrome';
  } else if (userAgent.indexOf('safari') != -1) {
    return 'Safari';
  } else if (userAgent.indexOf('firefox') != -1) {
    return 'Firefox';
  } else if (userAgent.indexOf('opera') != -1) {
    return 'Opera';
  } else {
    return 'Other';
  }
}
/**
 * アクセス元端末取得
 *
 * @returns {string}
 */


function getClientDevice() {
  var ua = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();

  if (ua.indexOf('iphone') > -1 || ua.indexOf('ipod') > -1 || ua.indexOf('android') > -1 && ua.indexOf('mobile') > -1) {
    return 'sp';
  } else if (ua.indexOf('android') > -1 || ua.indexOf('ipad') > -1 || ua.indexOf('macintosh') > -1 && 'ontouchend' in document) {
    return 'tab';
  } else {
    return 'pc';
  }
}
/**
 * jsonからお知らせ情報を取得し、ページに表示する
 */


function displayHeadersNotice() {
  // jsonファイルのURL
  var url_all = '/data/notice/all-01.json';
  var url_info = '/data/notice/info-01.json'; // テンプレートのid

  var noticeAllId = '#notice-all';
  var noticeInfoId = '#notice-info';
  var noticeAreaId = '#notice-area'; // all-01.jsonを取得

  axios.get(url_all).then(function (jsonData) {
    if (jsonData.data.title) {
      // お知らせ情報のテキストを追加
      $(noticeAllId).children('a').text(jsonData.data.title); // お知らせ情報のリンクを追加

      $(noticeAllId).children('a').attr('href', jsonData.data.link); // display:noneを無効化する

      $(noticeAllId).show();
      $(noticeAreaId).show();
    }
  })["catch"](function (error) {// 通常の運用でファイルがない場合もあるので何もしない。
  }); // info-01.jsonを取得

  axios.get(url_info).then(function (jsonData) {
    if (jsonData.data.title) {
      // お知らせ情報のテキストを追加
      $(noticeInfoId).children('a').text(jsonData.data.title); // お知らせ情報のリンクを追加

      $(noticeInfoId).children('a').attr('href', jsonData.data.link); // display:noneを無効化する

      $(noticeInfoId).show();
      $(noticeAreaId).show();
    }
  })["catch"](function (error) {// 通常の運用でファイルがない場合もあるので何もしない。
  });
}
/**
 * 同着オーバー時にcsvファイルから払戻金を取得してHTMLを作成する
 *
 * @param {object} date 日付
 * @param {string} placeKey 開催場キー
 * @param {int} raceNo レース番号
 *
 * @return {Promise} Promise
 */


function getIrregularRefundHtml(date, placeKey, raceNo) {
  // csvファイルの日付をYYYYmmddのフォーマットで取得
  var csvYear = date.getFullYear();
  var csvMonth = ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2);
  var csvDay = ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
  var csvDate = csvYear + csvMonth + csvDay; // レース番号を0を付けて取得

  var fixRaceNo = ('0' + raceNo).slice(-2); // csvファイルのURLを作成

  var csvUrl = '/data/refund/' + csvDate + '-' + placeKey + '-' + fixRaceNo + 'R-refund.csv'; // csvファイルを取得

  return axios.get(csvUrl).then(function (res) {
    if (res.data) {
      var rowList = res.data.replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n');
      var refundTemplate = $($('#template_irregular-refund').clone().html());
      rowList.forEach(function (value, index) {
        // 空行はスキップ
        if (value.trim() == '') return;
        var columnList = value.split(',');

        if (columnList[0]) {
          refundTemplate.find('dl').append('<dt>' + columnList[0] + '</dt>');
        }

        if (columnList[1]) {
          refundTemplate.find('dl').append('<dd>' + columnList[1] + '</dd>');
        }
      });
      return refundTemplate;
    } else {
      return "";
    }
  })["catch"](function (error) {
    return "";
  });
}
/**
 * 非開催のレース以外のリンクを表示する
 *
 * @param int finalRaceNo 最終レース番号
 */


function showRaceLink(finalRaceNo) {
  for (var i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
    if (i <= finalRaceNo) {
      // レース結果ページ・LIVEページ 1R～12Rのリンク（上部）
      $('#live-raceno-link').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').removeClass('d-none'); // レース結果ページ・LIVEページ 1R～12Rのリンク（下部）

      $('#live-raceno-link-bottom').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').removeClass('d-none'); // LIVEページ 試走・リプレイ 1R～12Rのリンク

      $('#live-vod-raceno-link').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').removeClass('d-none');
    } else {
      $('#live-raceno-link').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').addClass('d-none');
      $('#live-raceno-link-bottom').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').addClass('d-none');
      $('#live-vod-raceno-link').children('li:nth-child(' + i + ')').addClass('d-none');
    }
  }

  $('li[data-raceno="all"]').removeClass('d-none');
}
/**
 * 出走表・オッズの試走タイム表示作成
 *
 * @param {string} trialTime 試走タイム
 * @param {int} retryCode 再試走コード
 * @param {string} absent 欠車フラグ
 * @returns {string} 試走タイム
 */


function makeTrialHtml(trialTime, retryCode, absent) {
  var res = ''; // 欠車の場合でも試走タイムがあれば表示する

  if (trialTime && trialTime.match(/^[0-9\.]+$/)) {
    if (retryCode == 1) {
      res = '<font color="red">再</font>' + trialTime;
    } else {
      res = trialTime;
    }
  } else if (absent == 'K' || retryCode == 5) {
    res = '欠';
  } else if (retryCode == 6) {
    res = '停';
  }

  return res;
}
/**
 * 指定したIDの場所まで画面をスクロールする
 *
 * @param int domId 表示するDOMのID
 * @param string behavior スクロールの動作
 * @param string block 垂直方向の表示位置
 * @param string inline 水平方向の表示位置
 */


function scrollView(domId) {
  var behavior = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 'instant';
  var block = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : 'center';
  var inline = arguments.length > 3 && arguments[3] !== undefined ? arguments[3] : 'nearest';
  document.getElementById(domId).scrollIntoView({
    behavior: behavior,
    block: block,
    inline: inline
  });
}

   * 重勝式のフォーマット

   * @param {int} value
   * @returns {string}
   */


  function formatJushou(value) {
    if (value == null || value == 0) {
      return '0円';
    }

    return value.toLocaleString() + '円';
  }

function asyncGeneratorStep(gen, resolve, reject, _next, _throw, key, arg) { try { var info = gen[key](arg); var value = info.value; } catch (error) { reject(error); return; } if (info.done) { resolve(value); } else { Promise.resolve(value).then(_next, _throw); } }

function _asyncToGenerator(fn) { return function () { var self = this, args = arguments; return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) { var gen = fn.apply(self, args); function _next(value) { asyncGeneratorStep(gen, resolve, reject, _next, _throw, "next", value); } function _throw(err) { asyncGeneratorStep(gen, resolve, reject, _next, _throw, "throw", err); } _next(undefined); }); }; }

  /**
   * アクセスされたURLにより、表示するメニューや開催日など決定
   */


  function analyzeUrl() {
    var locationPathItemList = location.pathname.split('/'); // console.log(locationPathItemList)

    if (locationPathItemList.length >= 4) {
      // 開催場指定あり
      if (locationPathItemList[3]) {
        if (typeof _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[3]] !== 'undefined') {
          currentPlace = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[3]];
        } else {
          $('#live-other-message').text('URLエラー');
          urlError = true;
        }
      } // コンテンツ指定


      if (locationPathItemList[4]) {
        if (locationPathItemList[4] == 'RaceResult') {
          currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['result'];
        } else if (locationPathItemList[4] == 'Odds') {
          currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['odds'];
        } else if (locationPathItemList[4] == 'Program') {
          currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['program'];
        } else if (locationPathItemList[4] == 'Player') {
          currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['player'];
        } else if (locationPathItemList[4] == 'JushouResult') {
          currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['jushou'];
        } else {
          $('#live-other-message').text('URLエラー');
          urlError = true;
        }
      } // 開催日指定


      if (locationPathItemList[5]) {
        var raceDateNo = locationPathItemList[5].split('_');

        if (checkDate(raceDateNo[0])) {
          currentDate = new Date(raceDateNo[0]);
        } else {
          $('#live-other-message').text('URLエラー');
          urlError = true;
        }

        if (!raceDateNo[1]) {
          // レース番号の指定がない場合は1Rを表示
          currentRaceno = 1;
        } else {
          // レース番号指定
          if (checkRaceno(raceDateNo[1])) {
            currentRaceno = parseInt(raceDateNo[1]);
          } else {
            $('#race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
            urlError = true;
          }
        }
      } // 出走表サブコンテンツ指定


      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList['program'] && typeof programSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[6]] !== 'undefined') {
        currentProgramSubMenu = programSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[6]];
      } // オッズサブコンテンツ指定


      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList['odds'] && typeof oddsSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[6]] !== 'undefined') {
        currentOddsSubMenu = oddsSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[6]];
      }
    }
  }
  /**
   * videoのサイズをdomにフィットさせる
   */


  function fitVideoSize() {
    var videoDom = $('#live-video-container').children('div');
    var videoWidth = videoDom.width();
    var videoHeight = videoDom.height();
    var containerDom = $('#live-video-container');
    var containerWidth = containerDom.width();
    var containerHeight = containerDom.height();
    videoDom.width(containerWidth);
    videoDom.height(Math.floor(containerWidth * (videoHeight / videoWidth)));
  }
  /**
   * APIから情報取得し、表示
   *
   * @param boolean again 2回目以降の定期更新リクエスト
   * @param boolean browserBack ブラウザバック時のリクエスト
   */


  function render(again) {
    var browserBack = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
    // 現在のレース情報取得
    var url = '/race_info/XML/Hold/Today';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.get(url, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      // console.log(orgRes)
      var res = orgRes.data.body; // APIから現在年月日を取得

      nowDate = new Date(res.date.substr(0, 10)); // レース開催中の開催場取得

      currentActivePlace = [];
      res.today.forEach(function (t, tIndex) {
        currentActivePlace.push(t.placeCode);
        _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].renderPlacePlayIcon(t);

        if (t.placeCode == currentPlace) {
          // 現在レース中のレース番号を控える
          nowRaceNo = t.nowRaceNo;
        }
      });
      displayCancelTop = false;
      displayCancelMain = false;
      var isRaceDay = true; // 開催場、日付、レース番号の設定(レース情報の取得k)

      var thisRace = null;

      if (currentPlace) {
        res.today.forEach(function (t, tIndex) {
          if (t.placeCode == currentPlace) {
            thisRace = t;
          }
        });

        if (!thisRace) {
          isRaceDay = false;
        }
      } else {
        if (res.today.length === 0) {
          currentPlace = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi;
          isRaceDay = false;
        } else {
          thisRace = res.today[0];
          currentPlace = thisRace.placeCode;
          nowRaceNo = thisRace.nowRaceNo;
        }

        renderSubMenu();
      }

      if (!isRaceDay) {
        // 今日のレースがない(次回レース情報の取得)
        clearInterval(requestTimer);
        var nextRace = null;
        res.next.forEach(function (n, nIndex) {
          if (n.placeCode == currentPlace && n.periodStartDate != null) {
            nextRace = n;
          }
        });
        var noRaceMessage = '本日の開催情報はありません。';

        if (nextRace) {
          var nextRaceStartDate = new Date(nextRace.periodStartDate);
          var nextRaceEndDate = new Date(nextRace.periodEndDate);
          noRaceMessage = noRaceMessage + '<br><br>' + '次節　' + nextRace.title + '<br>' + '開催期間：' + nextRaceStartDate.getFullYear() + '年' + (nextRaceStartDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + nextRaceStartDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[nextRaceStartDate.getDay()] + ')' + '～' + nextRaceEndDate.getDate() + '日';
        }

        $('#live-race-title').html(noRaceMessage);
        $('#live-contents > div').hide();
        renderCommon();
      } else {
        // 二回開催チェック
        var twiceHoldFlag = twiceHoldCheck(res); // 切り替えボタン表示

        if (twiceHoldFlag) {
          var holdSwitching = $($('#template_live-hold-switching').clone().html());
          var firstHold = res.today.find(function (t) {
            return t.placeCode == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi;
          });
          var secondHold = res.today.find(function (t) {
            return t.placeCode == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2;
          }); // ２回開催時は２開催目の現在レース番号取得

          secondHoldNowRaceNo = twiceHoldNowRaceNo(firstHold, secondHold);
          holdSwitching.find("#live-switch-btn-kawaguchi").attr('href', '/race_info/Live/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[2]).html(firstHold.liveStartTime + '～' + firstHold.liveEndTime);
          holdSwitching.find("#live-switch-btn-kawaguchi2").attr('href', '/race_info/Live/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[12]).html(secondHold.liveStartTime + '～' + secondHold.liveEndTime);
          holdSwitching.find('#live-switch-btn-' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[currentPlace]).addClass("live-mainTab01__item--current");
          $('#live-hold-switch-area').html(holdSwitching);
        }

        $('#live-contents > div').show();

        if (!currentDate) {
          currentDate = nowDate;
        }

        if (!currentRaceno) {
          currentRaceno = thisRace.nowRaceNo;
        }

        justNowRaceno = thisRace.nowRaceNo;

        if (!currentVodRaceno) {
          currentVodRaceno = thisRace.nowRaceNo;
          renderLiveVideo();
        } // ◯日目タブ表示


        var periodStartDate = new Date(thisRace.periodStartDate);
        var periodEndDate = new Date(thisRace.periodEndDate);
        var termDay = (periodEndDate - periodStartDate) / 86400000 + 1;
        var periodDateTabs = $('<div></div>');

        for (var i = 0; i < termDay; i++) {
          // 未来日の◯日目タブは表示しない
          if (nowDate.getTime() < periodStartDate.getTime()) {
            continue;
          }

          var paragraphdayRow = $($('#template_live-paragraphday-row').clone().html());
          var dayNumStr = i + 1 + '日目';

          if (i === 0) {
            dayNumStr = '初日';
          }

          paragraphdayRow.children('a').text(dayNumStr);
          paragraphdayRow.attr('data-period-date', generateReqDate(periodStartDate));
          periodDateTabs.append(paragraphdayRow.clone());
          periodStartDate.setDate(periodStartDate.getDate() + 1);
        }

        $('#live-paragraphday-vod').html(periodDateTabs.clone().html());
        $('#live-paragraphday-main').html(periodDateTabs.clone().html()); // リクエストが終わるまでハイライトなしの状態になってしまうため、ここで一旦ハイライトする。

        $('li[data-period-date="' + generateReqDate(currentDate) + '"]').addClass('liveTabMenu__item--current'); // レース情報の反映

        if (!replayPlaying) {
          var liveInfoItem = $($('#template_live_race_info').clone().html());
          var raceClass = thisRace.raceClass ? thisRace.raceClass : '';
          var distance = thisRace.distance ? thisRace.distance : '-'; // レース名がついている場合は先頭に行追加

          if (thisRace.raceClass != thisRace.raceName) {
            var raceNameItem = $($('#template_live_race_info_race_name').clone().html());
            raceNameItem.find('p').text(thisRace.raceName);
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row2').before(raceNameItem);
          }

          liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row1 > p').text(thisRace.raceName);
          liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row2 > span:nth-child(1)').text(nowRaceNo + 'R ' + raceClass + ' ' + distance + 'm');

          if (thisRace.raceStartTime) {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row2 > span:nth-child(2) > span').text(thisRace.raceStartTime);
          }

          if (thisRace.weather) {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row2 > span:nth-child(3) > span').text(thisRace.weather);
          }

          if (thisRace.temp) {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row3 > p:nth-child(1) > span').text(thisRace.temp);
          }

          if (thisRace.humid) {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row3 > p:nth-child(2) > span').text(thisRace.humid);
          }

          if (thisRace.roadtemp) {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row3 > p:nth-child(3) > span').text(thisRace.roadtemp);
          }

          if (thisRace.situationCode != null || thisRace.situationCode != '') {
            liveInfoItem.find('#live_race_info_row3 > p:nth-child(4)').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].situationNameList[thisRace.situationCode]);
          }

          if (checkShowMiniPlayer()) {
            var miniPlayerBtnItem = $($('#template_live_mini_player_button').clone().html());
            liveInfoItem.append(miniPlayerBtnItem);
          }

          $('.liveInfo').html(liveInfoItem);
        }

        $('#live-race-title').html(thisRace.title + '<br class="d-block d-sm-none"><span class="small ml-3 liveTtl__time">第' + thisRace.paragraphday + '日目 ' + thisRace.liveStartTime + '～' + thisRace.liveEndTime + '</span>');
        $('#live-testdrive-raceno').text(thisRace.nowRaceNo); // 試走タイム表の反映

        renderTrialRun();
        $('#live-vote-info > p:nth-child(1) > span').text(thisRace.nowRaceNo);

        if (thisRace.preSale === 'preSale') {
          $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(1)').text('前売').removeClass('bg-warning').removeClass('text-dark').show();
        } else if (thisRace.preSale === 'thisTime') {
          $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(1)').text('当回').addClass('bg-warning').addClass('text-dark').show();
        } else {
          $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(1)').hide();
        }

        var telvoteTime = thisRace.telvoteClose ? '締切' : thisRace.telvoteTime;
        $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(2)').text(telvoteTime);

        if (thisRace.changeInetFlg == '1') {
          $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(3)').show();
        } else {
          $('#live-vote-info > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(3)').hide();
        }

        if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.program) {
          if (!again) {
            // 出走表表示
            renderProgram();
          }
        }

        if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.odds) {
          // オッズ表示
          renderOdds();
        }

        if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.result) {
          // レース結果表示
          renderResult();
        }

        if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.player) {
          if (!again) {
            // 出場選手表示
            renderPlayer();
          }
        }

        if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.jushou) {
          // 公式重勝式経過結果表示
          renderJushouResult();
        }
      } // URLの変更


      if (!again && !browserBack) {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", createUrl());
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
      clearInterval(requestTimer);
    });
  }
  /**
  * 二回開催チェック
  *
  * @param {object} res
  * @returns {int}
  */


  function twiceHoldCheck(res) {
    var flag = 0;

    if (locationPathItemList[3] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[2] || locationPathItemList[3] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[12]) {
      for (var i = 0; i < res.today.length; i++) {
        var t = res.today[i];

        if (t.placeCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2) {
          flag = 1;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    return flag;
  }
  /**
  * 2開催目の現在レース番号
  *
  * @param {object} firstHold
  * @param {object} secondHold
  * @returns {int}
  */


  function twiceHoldNowRaceNo(firstHold, secondHold) {
    if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi) {
      return secondHold.nowRaceNo;
    } else {
      return firstHold.nowRaceNo;
    }
  } // URLの作成


  function createUrl() {
    var url = '/race_info/Live/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[currentPlace] + '/' + mainMenuNameList[currentMainMenu] + '/' + generateReqDate(currentDate) + '_' + currentRaceno;

    if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'program') {
      return url + '/' + programSubMenuKeyList[currentProgramSubMenu];
    } else if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'odds') {
      return url + '/' + oddsSubMenuKeyList[currentOddsSubMenu];
    } else {
      return url;
    }
  }

  /**
   * バナー表示
   */


  function renderBanner() {
    var url = '/data/banner/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeKeyList[currentPlace] + '.csv';
    axios.get(url).then(function (res) {
      var rowList = res.data.replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n');
      $('#live-banner-container').empty();
      rowList.forEach(function (row) {
        // 空行はスキップ
        if (row.trim() == '') return;
        var columnList = row.split(',');
        var banner = $($('#template_live-banner').clone().html());

        if (columnList.length > 0 && columnList[0].trim() != '') {
          banner.find('span').text(columnList[0]);
        }

        if (columnList.length > 1 && columnList[1].trim() != '') {
          banner.find('a').attr('href', columnList[1]);
        } else {
          banner.find('a').attr('href', '#');
        }

        if (columnList.length > 2 && columnList[2].trim() != '') {
          var classList = columnList[2].split(' ');
          classList.forEach(function (className) {
            if (className.trim() != '') {
              banner.find('i').addClass(className);
            }
          });
        }

        $('#live-banner-container').append(banner);
      });
    });
  }
  /**
   * 開催情報、レース番号リンク表示
   *
   * @param {boolean} refundFlg　払戻確定フラグ
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   */


  function renderRaceInfo() {
    var refundFlg = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : false;
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': currentRaceno
    };
    var url = '/race_info/OtherRaceInfo';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      var res = orgRes.data.body; // レース番号リンク表示

      _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].showRaceLink(res.finalRaceNo); // 開催期間

      var startDate = new Date(res.periodStartDate);
      var endDate = new Date(res.periodEndDate);
      var dateStr = startDate.getFullYear() + '年' + (startDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + startDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[startDate.getDay()] + ')～';

      if (startDate.getFullYear() !== endDate.getFullYear()) {
        // 年またぎ
        dateStr = dateStr + endDate.getFullYear() + '年' + (endDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      } else if (startDate.getMonth() !== endDate.getMonth()) {
        // 月またぎ
        dateStr = dateStr + (endDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      } else {
        dateStr = dateStr + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      }

      var raceResultPeriod = $($('#template_live-race-period-time').clone().html());
      raceResultPeriod.children('div:nth-child(1)').children('span').text(res.raceName);
      raceResultPeriod.children('div:nth-child(1)').append('開催期間：' + dateStr + '　開催 第' + res.paragraphday + '日目');
      $('#live-race-period-time').html(raceResultPeriod.find('div'));
      var telvote = '<span class="mx-3">投票締切</span><br class="d-md-none">' + (res.telvoteTime || '');
      var raceStart = '<span class="mx-3">発走予定</span><br class="d-md-none">' + (res.raceStartTime || '');
      var changeItem = '<span class="text-red">[変更]</span>'; // 締切時刻変更

      if (res.changeInetFlg) {
        telvote += changeItem;
      } // 発走時刻変更


      if (res.changeStartFlg) {
        raceStart += changeItem;
      }

      $('#live-current-race-telvote').html(telvote);
      $('#live-current-race-start').html(raceStart); // 初期値はレース結果天候情報

      var weather = res.raceWeather;
      var temp = res.raceTemp;
      var humid = res.raceHumid;
      var roadtemp = res.raceRoadtemp;
      var situationCode = res.raceSituationCode; // レース結果タブの天候表示遷移
      // 0. 確定までお待ち下さい：現在の天候情報を表示
      // 1. 払戻金 & 3着まで確定：非表示
      // 2. グランドノート確定　：非表示
      // 3. 全着順確定　　　　　：レース結果天候情報を表示
      // 現在のページが「レース結果」以外 or 現在のページが「レース結果」で払戻が確定していない
      // ※払戻金が確定して以下if文に入らなくなるとレース結果天候情報を使おうとする。
      //   しかし、全着順が確定するまではレース結果天候情報にデータが入らないため、2. の状態までは天候欄は非表示となる。

      if (currentMainMenu != mainMenuCodeList.result || currentMainMenu != mainMenuCodeList.jushou || (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.result || currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.jushou) && refundFlg == false) {
        // 当日の開催中レースの場合は現在の天候情報を表示
        if (nowRaceNo == currentRaceno && currentDate.getTime() == nowDate.getTime()) {
          // TODO 最終レース天候反映暫定対応
          if (weather === null) {
            weather = res.weather;
          }

          if (temp === null) {
            temp = res.temp;
          }

          if (humid === null) {
            humid = res.humid;
          }

          if (roadtemp === null) {
            roadtemp = res.roadtemp;
          }

          if (situationCode === null) {
            situationCode = res.situationCode;
          }
        } // 開催中の前のレースでレース結果が確定していない場合は現在の天候情報を表示


        if (nowRaceNo - 1 == currentRaceno && currentDate.getTime() == nowDate.getTime()) {
          if (weather === null) {
            weather = res.weather;
          }

          if (temp === null) {
            temp = res.temp;
          }

          if (humid === null) {
            humid = res.humid;
          }

          if (roadtemp === null) {
            roadtemp = res.roadtemp;
          }

          if (situationCode === null) {
            situationCode = res.situationCode;
          }
        }
      }

      var thisDate = new Date(currentDate);
      var thisDateStr = thisDate.getMonth() + 1 + '月' + thisDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[thisDate.getDay()] + ')';
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(1)').text(thisDateStr);
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(2)').text((_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].raceClassNameList[res.classCode] || '') + (currentRaceno || '') + 'R');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(3)').text((res.distance || '') + 'm');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(4)').text(weather || '');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(1)').text((temp || '') + '℃');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(2)').text((humid || '') + '%');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(3)').text((roadtemp || '') + '℃');
      $('#live-current-race-info > div:nth-child(2) > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(4)').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].situationNameList[situationCode] || '');
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
        // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
        tokenErrorCount++;
        setTimeout(function () {
          renderRaceInfo(refundFlg, tokenErrorCount);
        }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.interval);
      } else {
        // 予期せぬエラー
        console.log(error);
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * 試走タイム表の表示 & 出走表表示実行
   *
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderTrialRun() {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : 0;
    var container = $('<div></div>');
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': justNowRaceno
    };
    var url = '/race_info/Program';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      $('#live-testdrive-message').text('').hide();
      $('#live-program > ul > li').show(); // console.log(orgRes)

      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
        if (orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] != _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
          $('#live-testdrive-message').text('試走タイムの取得に失敗しました。').show();
          renderCommon();
        }

        return;
      }

      var res = orgRes.data.body; // 試走タイム表

      $('#live-testdrive-rows').html('');

      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        var testdriveTableRow = $($('#template_live-testdrive-table-row').clone().html());

        if (i < res.playerList.length) {
          // 欠車の選手はグレーアウト
          if (res.playerList[i].absent == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].absentCode) {
            testdriveTableRow.addClass('dns-2-3');
          }

          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').text(res.playerList[i].carNo).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + res.playerList[i].carNo).slice(-2));
          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').html(_function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].makeTrialHtml(res.playerList[i].trialRunTime, res.playerList[i].trialRetryCode, res.playerList[i].absent));
          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(3)').text('H' + res.playerList[i].handicap);
        }

        if (i + 4 < res.playerList.length) {
          // 欠車の選手はグレーアウト
          if (res.playerList[i + 4].absent == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].absentCode) {
            testdriveTableRow.addClass('dns-5-6');
          }

          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(4)').text(res.playerList[i + 4].carNo).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + res.playerList[i + 4].carNo).slice(-2));
          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(5)').html(_function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].makeTrialHtml(res.playerList[i + 4].trialRunTime, res.playerList[i + 4].trialRetryCode, res.playerList[i + 4].absent));
          testdriveTableRow.children('td:nth-child(6)').text('H' + res.playerList[i + 4].handicap);
        }

        $('#live-testdrive-rows').append(testdriveTableRow);
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
        // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
        tokenErrorCount++;
        setTimeout(function () {
          renderTrialRun(tokenErrorCount);
        }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.interval);
      } else {
        // 予期せぬエラー
        console.log(error);
        $('#live-testdrive-message').text('試走タイムの取得に失敗しました。').show();
        renderCommon();
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * 出走表の表示
   *
   * @param {object} res 出走表APIレスポンスBODY
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderProgram(res) {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
    $('#live-program > ul > li').show(); // 同時進行でレース情報更新

    renderRaceInfo();

    if (res) {
      renderProgramByRes(res);
    } else {
      var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
      var params = {
        'placeCode': currentPlace,
        'raceDate': reqDate,
        'raceNo': currentRaceno
      };
      var url = '/race_info/Program';
      var options = {
        timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
      };
      axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
        if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
          if (orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
            displayCancelTop = true;
            displayCancelMain = true;
          } else {
            // 出走表がない
            $('#live-program > ul > li').hide();
            $('#live-program > div.live-program-submenu-container').text('出走表の取得に失敗しました。');
          }

          renderCommon();
          return;
        }

        var res = orgRes.data.body;
        renderProgramByRes(res);
      })["catch"](function (error) {
        if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
          // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
          tokenErrorCount++;
          setTimeout(function () {
            renderProgram(null, tokenErrorCount);
          }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.interval);
        } else {
          // 予期せぬエラー
          console.log(error);
          $('#live-program > ul > li').hide();
          $('#live-program > div.live-program-submenu-container').text('出走表の取得に失敗しました。');
          renderCommon();
        }
      });
    }
  }

    $('#live-program-han5-container').html(programHan5Table); // 近90走作成

      } // 選手情報

      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').children('a').attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + p.playerCode); // 選手画像のURL

      _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].updateImgSrc(programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').find('img'), '/race_info/image/photo_65-65/' + p.playerCode + '.jpg');
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').find('p').html(p.playerName + '<span>' + p.bikeName + '<br>' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[p.placeCode] + ' ' + p.graduationCode + '期<br>' + p.age + '歳' + ' ' + p.bikeClass + '級 ' + p.rank + '</span>'); // 近90走

      var thisData = res.latest90List[p.playerCode];
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(3)').text(thisData.runCount);
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(4)').text(thisData.advanceFinalCount);
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(5)').text(thisData.winCount);
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(6)').text(thisData.stAve);
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(7)').html(thisData.latest10OrderCount[1] + '/' + thisData.latest10OrderCount[2] + '<br>' + thisData.latest10OrderCount[3] + '/' + thisData.latest10OrderCount['ohter']);
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(8)').text(p.rate2 + '%');
      programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(9)').text(p.rate3 + '%'); // TODO goodTrackRaceBestPlaceCodeが欲しいかも

      if (thisData.goodTrackRaceBestPlace) {
        programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(10)').text(thisData.goodTrackTraialAve);
        programRecent90TableRow.children('td:nth-child(11)').text(thisData.goodTrackRaceAve);

      }

      programRecent90Table.find('tbody').append(programRecent90TableRow);
    });
    $('#live-program-recent90-container').html(programRecent90Table); // 近180走作成

    var programRecent180Table = $($('#template_live-program-recent180-table').clone().html());
    res.playerList.forEach(function (p, pIndex) {
      var programRecent180TableRow = $($('#template_live-program-recent180-table-row').clone().html()); // 欠車の選手はグレーアウト

      if (p.absent == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].absentCode) {
        programRecent180TableRow.addClass('dns-2');
      } // 選手情報


      programRecent180TableRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').text(p.carNo).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + p.carNo).slice(-2));
      programRecent180TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').children('a').attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + p.playerCode); // 選手画像のURL

      _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].updateImgSrc(programRecent180TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').find('img'), '/race_info/image/photo_65-65/' + p.playerCode + '.jpg');
      programRecent180TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').find('p').html(p.playerName + '<span>' + p.bikeName + '<br>' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[p.placeCode] + ' ' + p.graduationCode + '期<br>' + p.age + '歳' + ' ' + p.bikeClass + '級 ' + p.rank + '</span>'); // 近180走

    res.playerList.forEach(function (p, pIndex) {

      programRecent365TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').children('a').attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + p.playerCode); // 選手画像のURL

      programRecent365TableRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').find('p').html(p.playerName + '<span>' + p.bikeName + '<br>' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[p.placeCode] + ' ' + p.graduationCode + '期<br>' + p.age + '歳' + ' ' + p.bikeClass + '級 ' + p.rank + '</span>'); // 集計データ

    if (_function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].getClientDevice() == 'pc') {
