  /**
   * オッズの表示
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderOdds() {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : 0;
    // 同時進行でレース情報更新
    renderRaceInfo();
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': currentRaceno
    };
    var allPlayerNumberList = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]; // APIリクエスト

    var url = '/race_info/Odds';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      $('#live-odds > ul > li').show(); // console.log(orgRes)

      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
        if (orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
          displayCancelTop = true;
          displayCancelMain = true;
        }

        renderCommon();
        return;
      }

      var res = orgRes.data.body;
      var countPlayer = res.playerList.length; // 予想表作成

      var expectedTable;

      if (res.twicePlayerExist == 1) {
        expectedTable = $($('#template_live-odds-expected-table-with-hayami').clone().html());
      } else {
        expectedTable = $($('#template_live-odds-expected-table').clone().html());
      }

      res.playerList.forEach(function (p, pIndex) {
        var expectedRow;

        if (res.twicePlayerExist == 1) {
          expectedRow = $($('#template_live-odds-expected-row-with-hayami').clone().html());
        } else {
          expectedRow = $($('#template_live-odds-expected-row').clone().html());
        } // 欠車の選手はグレーアウト


        if (p.absent == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].absentCode) {
          if (res.aiExpectConfirmFlag == 0 && p.carNo != 1) {
            expectedRow.addClass('dns-4-12');
          } else {
            expectedRow.addClass('dns-5-13');
          }
        }

        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').html($($('#template_live-odds-expected-ico-' + p.aiExpectCode).clone().html()));
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(2)').html($($('#template_live-odds-expected-ico-' + p.sunnyExpectCode).clone().html()));
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(3)').html($($('#template_live-odds-expected-ico-' + p.rainExpectCode).clone().html()));
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(4)').text(p.carNo).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + p.carNo).slice(-2));
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(5)').find('p').html(p.playerName + '<span>' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[p.placeCode] + ' ' + p.graduationCode + '期</span>');
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(5)').find('a').attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + p.playerCode);
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(6)').text(p.handicap);
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(7)').html(_function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].makeTrialHtml(p.trialTime, p.trialRetryCode, p.absent));
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(8)').text(p.raceDev);
        expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(9)').text(p.stAve); // 良10走(平均試走T・平均競走T・最高競走T)

        if (p.goodTrackRaceBestPlace) {
          expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(10)').text(p.goodTrackTraialAve);
          expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(11)').text(p.goodTrackRaceAve);
          expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(12)').text(p.goodTrackRaceBest);
        } // 早見


        if (p.anotherRaceNo) {
          expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(13)').children('a').attr('data-raceno', p.anotherRaceNo).text(p.anotherRaceNo + 'R');
        }

        if (p.anotherRaceNo2) {
          var hayamiPlaceCode;

          if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi) {
            hayamiPlaceCode = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2;
          }

          if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2) {
            hayamiPlaceCode = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi;
          }

          expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(13)').children('a').attr({
            'data-raceno': p.anotherRaceNo2,
            'data-hayamiPlaceNo': hayamiPlaceCode
          }).text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].hayamiCount[hayamiPlaceCode] + '回目' + p.anotherRaceNo2 + 'R');
        }

        if (currentDate.getTime() < new Date(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].aiExpectStartDate).getTime()) {
          // AI予想リリース前
          if (p.carNo == 1) {
            expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').attr('rowspan', countPlayer).html('<p>-</p>');
          } else {
            expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').remove();
          }
        } else if (res.aiExpectConfirmFlag == 0) {
          // AI予想確定前
          if (p.carNo == 1) {
            expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').addClass('live-oddsTable__name').attr('rowspan', countPlayer).html('<p>試走後に表示</p>');
          } else {
            expectedRow.children('td:nth-child(1)').remove();
          }
        }

        expectedTable.find('tbody').append(expectedRow);
      }); // オッズ情報がない

      if (res.rtwOddsList.length == 0) {
        $('#live-odds > ul > li').hide();
        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').html(expectedTable.clone()); // 「AI予想とは」表示

        var _oddsUpdateTime = $($('#template_odds-update-time').clone().html());

        _oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').hide();

        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').append(_oddsUpdateTime);
        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').append('オッズの表示までしばらくお待ち下さい。');
        renderCommon();
        return;
      } // 予想ブロック雛形作成


      var expectedBlock = $($('#template_live-odds-expected-block').clone().html());
      var expectedInfo = res.expectInfo;
      expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(1)').children('div').children('div').text(expectedInfo.ai.join(' '));
      expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(2)').children('div').children('div').text(expectedInfo.sunny.join(' '));
      expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(3)').children('div').children('div').text(expectedInfo.rain.join(' '));

      if (expectedInfo.ai.length == 0) {
        // AI予想データなし
        expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(1)').hide();
      }

      if (expectedInfo.sunny.length == 0) {
        // 予想データなし
        expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(2)').hide();
        expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(3)').hide();
        expectedBlock.children('div:nth-child(5)').hide();
      } // 2/3連単表作成


      var oddsRt23 = $('<div></div>');
      var oddsRt23List = $($('#template_live-odds-player-list-rt23').clone().html());
      var updateDate = new Date(res.salesInfo.updateDate.replace(/\-/g, '/'));
      var updateHour = ('0' + updateDate.getHours()).slice(-2);
      var updateMinutes = ('0' + updateDate.getMinutes()).slice(-2); // オッズ更新時刻・オッズ確定配置

      var oddsUpdateTime = $($('#template_odds-update-time').clone().html());

      if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['undeterminedOdds']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').text('オッズ更新 ' + updateHour + ':' + updateMinutes);
      } else if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['determinedOdds']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').addClass('border-danger text-danger').text('オッズ確定');
      } else if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['oddsUpdateError']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').addClass('border-warning bg-light-orange').text('オッズ更新エラー');
      }

      oddsRt23.append(oddsUpdateTime);
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var p = pNumIndex < res.playerList.length ? res.playerList[pNumIndex] : null;
        var playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
        playerNumberList.splice(playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1); // console.log(playerNumberList)

        var playerRt23 = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23').clone().html());
        var rt2OddsList = res.rtwOddsList;
        var rt3OddsList = res.rt3OddsList; // 表1行目

        var playerRt23Row1st = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-1st').clone().html());
        playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(1)').text(pNum).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));
        if (p) playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(2)').children('p').text(p.playerName);
        playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(2)').addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));

        for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
          // 車番
          playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(' + ((i + 1) * 2 + 1) + ')').text(playerNumberList[i]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[i]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

          var thisOdds = p && i < res.playerList.length - 1 ? rt2OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[i]] : '';
          var thisClass = generateOddsClass(thisOdds);
          playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(' + ((i + 1) * 2 + 2) + ')').text(thisOdds).addClass(thisClass);
        }

        playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row1st); // 表2行目

        var playerRt23Row2nd = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-2nd').clone().html());

        for (var _i = 0; _i < 7; _i++) {
          var playerNumberList2 = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
          playerNumberList2.splice(playerNumberList2.indexOf(pNum), 1);
          playerNumberList2.splice(playerNumberList2.indexOf(playerNumberList[_i]), 1); // 車番

          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 1) + ')').text(playerNumberList[_i]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[_i]).slice(-2));
          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 2) + ')').text(playerNumberList2[0]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[_i]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

          var _thisOdds = p && _i < res.playerList.length - 1 ? rt3OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[_i]][playerNumberList2[0]] : '';

          var _thisClass = generateOddsClass(_thisOdds);

          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 3) + ')').text(_thisOdds).addClass(_thisClass);
        }

        playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row2nd); // 表3～7行目

        for (var _i2 = 0; _i2 < 5; _i2++) {
          var playerRt23Row3rd = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-3rd-or-later').clone().html());

          for (var j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            var _playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();

            _playerNumberList.splice(_playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1);

            _playerNumberList.splice(_playerNumberList.indexOf(playerNumberList[j]), 1); // 車番


            playerRt23Row3rd.children('td:nth-child(' + (j * 2 + 1) + ')').text(_playerNumberList[_i2 + 1]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[j]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

            var _thisOdds2 = p && j < res.playerList.length - 1 && _i2 + 1 < res.playerList.length - 2 ? rt3OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[j]][_playerNumberList[_i2 + 1]] : '';

            var _thisClass2 = generateOddsClass(_thisOdds2);

            playerRt23Row3rd.children('td:nth-child(' + (j * 2 + 2) + ')').text(_thisOdds2).addClass(_thisClass2);
          }

          playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row3rd);
        }

        oddsRt23List.children('div').children('div').append(playerRt23);
      });
      oddsRt23.append(oddsRt23List.html());
      $('#live-odds-rt23-container').html(oddsRt23.html()); // 3連単表作成

      var rt3PlayerNumberList = {};
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
        playerNumberList.splice(playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1);
        rt3PlayerNumberList[pNum] = playerNumberList;
      }); // console.log(rt3PlayerNumberList)

      var oddsRt3 = $('<div></div>'); // オッズ更新時刻・オッズ確定配置

      oddsRt3.append(oddsUpdateTime);
      var oddsRt3Axis = $($('#template_live-odds-rt3-axis-link').clone().html());
      oddsRt3.append(oddsRt3Axis);
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var p = pNumIndex < res.playerList.length ? res.playerList[pNumIndex] : null; // 雛形(2テーブル)に車番号など適用

        var oddsRt3Tables = $($('#template_live-odds-rt3-tables').clone().html());
        oddsRt3Tables.attr('data-odds-rt3-tables-axis', pNum);
        var playerNameContainer = p ? $('<p></p>').text(p.carNo + ' ' + p.playerName) : '';

        if (pNum < 5) {
          // 車番1～4は上のテーブル
          oddsRt3Tables.find('table:nth-child(2)').find('td:nth-child(' + pNum + ')').append(playerNameContainer).attr('rowspan', '7').removeClass('raceNum').addClass('live-oddsTable__name').addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));
        } else {
          // 車番5～8は下のテーブル
          oddsRt3Tables.find('table:nth-child(4)').find('td:nth-child(' + (pNum - 4) + ')').append(playerNameContainer).attr('rowspan', '7').removeClass('raceNum').addClass('live-oddsTable__name').addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));
        }

        var pNumCount = 0;

  function renderPlayer() {

    // 同時進行でレース情報更新
    renderRaceInfo();
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate
    }; // APIリクエスト

    var url = '/race_info/Player';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      // console.log(orgRes)
      var res = orgRes.data.body;

      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure' || res.length == 0) {
        // 出場選手情報がない
        displayCancelTop = true;
        displayCancelMain = true;
        renderCommon();
        return;
      }

      var playerContainer = $($('#template_live-player-container').clone().html());
      res.forEach(function (d) {
        d.playerRank.forEach(function (r) {
          var playerRank = $($('#template_live-player-rank').clone().html());

          playerContainer.append(playerRank);

            playerContainer.append(playerLg);
            var playerList = $($('#template_live-player-list').clone().html());
            l.playerList.forEach(function (p) {
              var playerRow = $($('#template_live-player-row').clone().html());
              playerRow.children('dt').text(p.graduationCode + '期');
              playerRow.find('a').text(p.playerName).attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + p.playerCode);

              if (p.recommendCode) {
                var playerRecommend = $($('#template_live-player-recommend-' + p.recommendCode.toLowerCase()).clone().html());
                playerRow.find('a').append(playerRecommend);
              }

              playerList.append(playerRow.html());
            });
            playerContainer.append(playerList);
          });
        });
      });
      $('#live-player').html(playerContainer);
      checkCancelForPlayer();
    })["catch"](function (error) {

  function changeDisplayJushou() {

    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var jushoApiparams = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,

    };

        displayJushou = false;
      }
    });

  function generateRecentOrderTime(race) {

    if (race.order == 0) {

    } else if (race.order == 9) {

      time = race.raceTime; // 通常レース
    } else if (race.order != null && race.order != '') {

      time = race.raceTime;
    }

      'time': time
    };

    if (ref.typeCode == 1) {

    if (odds === '' || odds === null) {

      return 'RateLow';
    } else if (odds >= 100.0) {

   * @returns {string} 日付文字列
   */


  function generateReqDate(date) {
    return date.getFullYear() + '-' + ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
  }
  /**
   * 日付文字列の妥当性チェック
   *
   * @param string strDate 日付文字列
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function checkDate(strDate) {
    if (strDate.match(/^\d{4}\-\d{2}\-\d{2}$/) == null) {
      return false;
    }

    var y = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[0]);
    var m = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[1]) - 1;
    var d = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[2]);
    var date = new Date(y, m, d);

    if (date.getFullYear() != y || date.getMonth() != m || date.getDate() != d) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**
   * レース番号の妥当性チェック
   *
   * @param string strRaceno レース番号文字列
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function checkRaceno(strRaceno) {
    if (strRaceno.match(/^\d{1,2}$/) == null) {
      return false;
    }

    if (parseInt(strRaceno) < 1 || parseInt(strRaceno) > 12) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**

  function checkShowMiniPlayer() {
    // userAgent取得
    var ua = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();

    if (ua.indexOf('iphone') > -1 || ua.indexOf('ipad') > -1 || ua.indexOf('macintosh') > -1 && 'ontouchend' in document) {
      // osのバーション取得
      var osVersion = ua.match(/os (.+?) like/)[1]; // バーション14以下の場合は非表示

      if (parseFloat(osVersion.replace('_', '.')) < 14) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  } // ブラウザバック用の履歴作成

    window.history.pushState(null, "", createUrl());

  /**
   *  ボタン押下時の期間セット
   *
   * @param {date} periodStartDate
   */

  function setPeriod(periodStartDate) {
    var today = new Date();
    $('#profile_search_result_start_date').val(generatePeriodDate(periodStartDate));
    $('#profile_search_result_end_date').val(generatePeriodDate(today));
  }
  /**
   * 期間セット用の日付文字列を生成
   *
   * @param {date} 日付インスタンス
   * @returns {string} 日付文字列
   */


  function generatePeriodDate(date) {
    return date.getFullYear() + '/' + (date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0') + '/' + date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function getProfile(playerCode) {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
    var url = '/race_info/Profile'; // パラメータセット

    var params = {

      if (characteristics.length !== 0) {

        characteristicsList.find('#profile_course').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].courseList[characteristics.course]);

      } // ランク・ポイント


      $('#profile_current_rank').text(profile.currentRank);

      $('#profile_total_res_win_count').text(totalResult.winCount);

        tokenErrorCount++;

          getProfile(playerCode, tokenErrorCount);

  /**
   * レース成績検索リクエスト
   *
   * @param {boolean} accessCallFlg 画面アクセス時の呼び出しフラグ
   * @param {boolean} searchFormFlg 検索フォームフラグ
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   */


  function searchPlayerResult() {
    var accessCallFlg = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : false;
    var searchFormFlg = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : 0;
    // 検索フォーム用変数
    var formStartDate = '';
    var formEndDate = '';
    var formPlaceCodeList = [];
    var formGradeList = [];
    var formHandicapList = [];
    var formRaceClassList = [];
    var formBikeClassList = [];
    var formOrderList = [];
    var formHoldTypeList = [];
    var formOpenraceList = [];
    var formSituationList = [];
    var formCarNoList = [];
    var url = '/race_info/SearchPlayerResult';
    var params = searchResultValue;

    if (searchFormFlg === true) {
      // 検索フォームから呼び出し時はフォームの値を取得
      formStartDate = $('#profile_search_result_start_date').val().replace(/\//g, '-');
      formEndDate = $('#profile_search_result_end_date').val().replace(/\//g, '-');
      $('input:checkbox[name="place-code"]:checked').each(function () {
        formPlaceCodeList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="grade"]:checked').each(function () {
        formGradeList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="handicap"]:checked').each(function () {
        formHandicapList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="race-type"]:checked').each(function () {
        formRaceClassList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="bike-class"]:checked').each(function () {
        formBikeClassList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="race-result"]:checked').each(function () {
        formOrderList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="race-category"]:checked').each(function () {
        formHoldTypeList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="open-handi"]:checked').each(function () {
        formOpenraceList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="situation"]:checked').each(function () {
        formSituationList.push($(this).val());
      });
      $('input:checkbox[name="bike-number"]:checked').each(function () {
        formCarNoList.push($(this).val());
      });
      params = {
        'playerCode': playerCode,
        'startDate': formStartDate,
        'endDate': formEndDate,
        'placeCodeList': formPlaceCodeList,
        'gradeList': formGradeList,
        'handicapList': formHandicapList,
        'raceClassList': formRaceClassList,
        'bikeClassList': formBikeClassList,
        'orderList': formOrderList,
        'holdTypeList': formHoldTypeList,
        'openraceList': formOpenraceList,
        'situationList': formSituationList,
        'carNoList': formCarNoList,
        'page': 1
      };
    }

    axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
      if (res.data.result == 'Failure') {
        if (accessCallFlg === true) {
          // 画面アクセス時に表示するレースがない場合、検索条件のみ表示
          $('#profile_search_date_place_condition').text('全期間｜全国');
          $('#profile_search_detail_condition').text('検索条件：指定なし');
        } else if (res.data.errors[0].code == '4101') {
          $('#profile_search_result_form_other_message').text('条件に一致するレースはありません。');
        } else {
          res.data.errors.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.code == '4003' || e.code == '4004') {
              $('#profile_search_result_form_date_message').text('期間が不正な値です。');
            } else if (e.code == '4005') {
              $('#profile_search_result_form_place_message').text('開催場を選択して下さい。');
            } else {
              $('#profile_search_result_form_other_message').text('予期せぬエラーが発生しました。');
            }
          });
        }

        return;
      }

      if (searchFormFlg === true) {
        // フォームから呼び出し時、バリデーションエラーなければオブジェクト更新
        searchResultValue = params;
      }

      var container = $('<div></div>');
      var currentPage = res.data.body.currentPage;
      var lastPage = res.data.body.lastPage;
      res.data.body.resultList.forEach(function (d) {
        var resultPageUrl = '/race_info/RaceResult/' + d.placeKey + '/' + d.raceDate + '_' + d.raceNo;
        var splitRaceDate = d.raceDate.split('-');
        var year = splitRaceDate[0].slice(-2);
        var month = splitRaceDate[1];
        var day = splitRaceDate[2];

        if (month.slice(0, 1) == 0) {
          month = month.slice(1);
        }

        if (day.slice(0, 1) == 0) {
          day = day.slice(1);
        } // 開催日表示用


        var displayRaceDate = year + '/' + month + '/' + day; // 着順欄

        var order;

        if (d.order == 0) {
          // 不正立・中止
          order = d.materializedName;
        } else if (d.order == 9) {
          // 事故
          order = d.accidentName;
        } else {
          // 通常
          order = d.order + '着';
        } // 3着以内は色付け


        var orderClass = '';

        if (d.order === 1) {
          orderClass = 'bg-light-danger';
        } else if (d.order === 2) {
          orderClass = 'bg-light-primary';
        } else if (d.order === 3) {
          orderClass = 'bg-light-success';
        }

        var raceTime = '';

        if (d.startedCode1 === 1) {
          // フライング表示
          raceTime = '<font color="red">F</font>';
        }

        if (d.raceTime) {
          // 競走タイム追加
          raceTime = raceTime + d.raceTime;
        } // 検索結果表示


        container.append($('<tr></tr>').append($('<td></td>').append(d.gradeName)).append($('<td></td>').append(d.placeName)).append($('<td></td>').append(displayRaceDate)).append($('<td></td>').addClass('font-weight-bold').append($('<a></a>').attr('href', resultPageUrl).text(d.raceNo + 'R').addClass('text-link--underline text-danger'))).append($('<td></td>').append(d.raceType)).append($('<td></td>').addClass(orderClass).append(order)).append($('<td></td>').append(d.traialTime)).append($('<td></td>').append(raceTime)).append($('<td></td>').append(d.st)));
      }); // 検索条件表示用

      var dateCondition = '';
      var placeCondition = '';
      var detailConditionList = [];
      var detailCondition; // 期間検索条件

      if (searchResultValue.startDate === '' && searchResultValue.endDate === '') {
        // 期間開始日・期間終了日どちらも未選択時は全期間表示
        dateCondition = '全期間';
      } else {
        dateCondition = searchResultValue.startDate.replace(/-/g, '/') + '～' + searchResultValue.endDate.replace(/-/g, '/');
      } // 開催場検索条件


      if (searchResultValue.placeCodeList.length === allPlace.length || searchResultValue.placeCodeList.length === 0) {
        // 全場表示時は全国表示
        placeCondition = '全国';
      } else {
        searchResultValue.placeCodeList.forEach(function (place, i) {
          if (i > 0) {
            placeCondition = placeCondition + '、';
          }

          placeCondition = placeCondition + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].placeNameList[place];
        });
      } // グレード検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.gradeList.forEach(function (grade) {
        detailCondition.push(searchGradeList[grade]);
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // ハンデ検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.handicapList.forEach(function (handicap) {
        if (handicap == 60) {
          detailCondition.push(handicap + 'm以上');
        } else {
          detailCondition.push(handicap + 'm');
        }
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // レース種別検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.raceClassList.forEach(function (raceClass) {
        detailCondition.push(searchRaceClassList[raceClass]);
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 車級検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.bikeClassList.forEach(function (bikeClass) {
        detailCondition.push(bikeClass + '級');
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 着順検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.orderList.forEach(function (order) {
        detailCondition.push(order + '着');
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 開催種別検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.holdTypeList.forEach(function (holdType) {
        detailCondition.push(searchHoldTypeList[holdType]);
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // オープン戦検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.openraceList.forEach(function (openrace) {
        detailCondition.push(searchOpenraceList[openrace]);
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 走路状況検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.situationList.forEach(function (situation) {
        detailCondition.push(searchSituationList[situation]);
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 車番検索条件


      detailCondition = [];
      searchResultValue.carNoList.forEach(function (carNo) {
        detailCondition.push(carNo + '号車');
      });

      if (detailCondition.length !== 0) {
        detailConditionList.push(detailCondition.join('、'));
      } // 期間・開催場検索条件表示


      $('#profile_search_date_place_condition').text(dateCondition + '｜' + placeCondition); // 詳細条件表示

      if (detailConditionList.length !== 0) {
        $('#profile_search_detail_condition').text(detailConditionList.join('｜'));
      } else {
        $('#profile_search_detail_condition').text('検索条件：指定なし');
      } // 検索結果表示


      $('.individual-resultTable tbody').eq(1).html(container.html()); // ページリンク作成

      makeSearchResultPageLink(currentPage, lastPage);
      deferred.resolve();
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
        // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
        tokenErrorCount++;
        setTimeout(function () {
          searchPlayerResult(accessCallFlg, searchFormFlg, tokenErrorCount);
        }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].tokenError.interval);
      } else {
        console.log(error);
        $('#profile_search_result_form_other_message').text('予期せぬエラーが発生しました。');
        return;
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * 動画表示
   *
   * @param string videoUrl 選手動画URL
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function setPlayerVideo(videoUrl) {
    // 動画が無い選手は該当divを非表示
    if (videoUrl == null) {
      $('#profile_video_div').hide();
    } else {
      // 選手動画jQueryオブジェクト
      var videoItem = $($('#template_profile_player_video').clone().html()); // 森選手用jQueryオブジェクト

      var moriVideoItem = $($('#template_profile_player_video_mori').clone().html()); // 森選手のみ特別ページへのリンクにする

      if (playerCode == '2529') {
        $('#profile_video_div').append(moriVideoItem);
      } else {
        videoItem.find('iframe').attr('src', videoUrl);
        $('#profile_video_div').append(videoItem);
      }
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 主な獲得タイトルテーブル作成
   *
   * @param {object} list グレードごとの獲得タイトル情報
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function makeTitleTable(list) {
    var rank = null;

  /**
   * レース成績検索ページリンク作成
   *
   * @param {int} currentPage 現在のページ番号
   * @param {int} lastPage 最終ページ番号
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function makeSearchResultPageLink(currentPage, lastPage) {
    // ページリンクテンプレート
    var pageLinkArea = $($('#template_profile_search_result_page_link').clone().html());
    var previousPage = currentPage - 1;
    var nextPage = currentPage + 1; // 現在のページ番号と最終ページ番号の差

    var diffPageCurrentToLast = lastPage - currentPage; // 前半部分ページリンク作成

    if (currentPage >= 4) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(previousPage, '前へ', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(1, '1', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkDisabledItem('...', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(previousPage, previousPage, pageLinkArea);
    } else if (currentPage === 3) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(previousPage, '前へ', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(1, '1', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(previousPage, previousPage, pageLinkArea);
    } else if (currentPage === 2) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(previousPage, '前へ', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(1, '1', pageLinkArea);
    } else if (currentPage === 1) {
      makePageLinkDisabledItem('前へ', pageLinkArea);
    } // 現在のページ番号表示


    makePageLinkEnabledItem(currentPage, currentPage, pageLinkArea, true); // 後半部分ページリンク作成

    if (diffPageCurrentToLast >= 3) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(nextPage, nextPage, pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkDisabledItem('...', pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(lastPage, lastPage, pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(nextPage, '次へ', pageLinkArea);
    } else if (diffPageCurrentToLast === 2) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(nextPage, nextPage, pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(lastPage, lastPage, pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(nextPage, '次へ', pageLinkArea);
    } else if (diffPageCurrentToLast === 1) {
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(lastPage, lastPage, pageLinkArea);
      makePageLinkEnabledItem(nextPage, '次へ', pageLinkArea);
    } else if (diffPageCurrentToLast === 0) {
      makePageLinkDisabledItem('次へ', pageLinkArea);
    }

    $('#profile_search_result_page_link').html(pageLinkArea);
  }

      currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['odds'];
    } else if (locationPathItemList[2] == 'Program') {
      currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['program'];
    } else if (locationPathItemList[2] == 'JushouResult') {
      currentMainMenu = mainMenuCodeList['jushou'];
    } else {
      $('#race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
      urlError = true;
    } // 開催場指定


    if (typeof _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[3]] !== 'undefined') {
      currentPlace = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList[locationPathItemList[3]];
    } else {
      $('#race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
      urlError = true;
    } // 開催日指定


    var raceDateNo = locationPathItemList[4].split('_');

    if (checkDate(raceDateNo[0])) {
      currentDate = new Date(raceDateNo[0]);
    } else {
      $('#race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
      urlError = true;
    }

    if (!raceDateNo[1]) {
      // レース番号の指定がない場合は1Rを表示
      currentRaceno = 1;
    } else {
      // レース番号指定
      if (checkRaceno(raceDateNo[1])) {
        if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'result' && raceDateNo[1] == 'all') {
          currentAllRaceClicked = true;
          currentRaceno = 'all';
        } else {
          currentAllRaceClicked = false;
          currentRaceno = parseInt(raceDateNo[1]);
        }
      } else {
        $('#race-result-other-message').text('URLエラー');
        urlError = true;
      }
    } // クエリパラメータ取得


    if (location.search) {
      console.log(location.search);
      var params = {};
      var query = location.search.substr(1);
      query.split("&").forEach(function (q) {
        var item = q.split("=");
        params[item[0]] = item[1];
      }); // 全レース

      if ('all' in params && params.all == 1) {
        currentAllRaceClicked = true;
      } // 前夜版


      if ('next' in params && params.next == 1) {
        lastNightFlg = true;
      }
    } // 出走表サブコンテンツ指定


    if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList['program'] && typeof programSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[5]] !== 'undefined') {
      currentProgramSubMenu = programSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[5]];
    } // オッズサブコンテンツ指定


    if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList['odds'] && typeof oddsSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[5]] !== 'undefined') {
      currentOddsSubMenu = oddsSubMenuCodeList[locationPathItemList[5]];
    } // 前夜版かつオートレースモバイル廃止日以降


    if (lastNightFlg && currentDate.getTime() >= new Date(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].mobileAbolitionDate).getTime()) {
      // 表の見方にAI予想についての説明付きテンプレートを表示
      $('.ai-predictions-explanation').html($('#template_read-list-lastNight').clone().html());
    }
  }
  /**
   * APIから情報取得し、表示
   *
   * @param boolean again 2回目以降の定期更新リクエスト
   * @param boolean browserBack ブラウザバック時のリクエスト
   */


  function render(again) {
    var browserBack = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
    displayCancelMain = false;
    $('#live-contents > div').show(); // 現在のレース情報取得

    var url = '/race_info/XML/Hold/Today';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.get(url, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      // console.log(orgRes)
      var res = orgRes.data.body; // APIから現在年月日を取得

      nowDate = new Date(res.date.substr(0, 10)); // レース開催中の開催場取得

      currentActivePlace = [];
      res.today.forEach(function (t, tIndex) {
        currentActivePlace.push(t.placeCode);
        _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].renderPlacePlayIcon(t);

        if (t.placeCode == currentPlace) {
          // 現在レース中のレース番号を控える
          nowRaceNo = t.nowRaceNo;
        }
      }); // 二回開催チェック

      var twiceHoldFlag = twiceHoldCheck(res);

      if (twiceHoldFlag) {
        var firstHold = res.today.find(function (t) {
          return t.placeCode == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi;
        });
        var secondHold = res.today.find(function (t) {
          return t.placeCode == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2;
        }); // ２回開催時は２開催目の現在レース番号取得

        secondHoldNowRaceNo = twiceHoldNowRaceNo(firstHold, secondHold);
      } // 当日以外は定期更新なし


      if (currentDate.getTime() != nowDate.getTime()) {
        clearInterval(requestTimer);
      }

      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.program) {
        if (!again) {
          // 出走表表示
          renderProgram();
        }
      }

      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.odds) {
        // オッズ表示
        renderOdds();
      }

      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.result) {
        if (currentAllRaceClicked === true) {
          // レース結果表示(全レース)
          renderRefund();
        } else {
          // レース結果表示
          renderResult();
        }
      }

      if (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.jushou) {
        // 公式重勝式経過結果表示
        renderJushouResult();
      } // URLの変更


      if (!again && !browserBack) {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", createUrl());
      }
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      console.log(error);
      clearInterval(requestTimer);
    });
  }
  /**
  * 二回開催チェック
  *
  * @param {object} res
  * @returns {int}
  */


  function twiceHoldCheck(res) {
    var flag = 0;

    if (locationPathItemList[3] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[2] || locationPathItemList[3] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[12]) {
      for (var i = 0; i < res.today.length; i++) {
        var t = res.today[i];

        if (t.placeCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2) {
          flag = 1;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    return flag;
  }
  /**
   * 2開催目の現在レース番号
   *
   * @param {object} firstHold
   * @param {object} secondHold
   * @returns {int}
   */


  function twiceHoldNowRaceNo(firstHold, secondHold) {
    if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi) {
      return secondHold.nowRaceNo;
    } else {
      return firstHold.nowRaceNo;
    }
  } // URLの作成


  function createUrl() {
    var url = '/race_info/' + mainMenuNameList[currentMainMenu] + '/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[currentPlace] + '/' + generateReqDate(currentDate) + '_' + currentRaceno;

    if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'program') {
      url += '/' + programSubMenuKeyList[currentProgramSubMenu];

      if (lastNightFlg) {
        return url + '?next=1';
      } else {
        return url;
      }
    } else if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'odds') {
      return url + '/' + oddsSubMenuKeyList[currentOddsSubMenu];
    } else if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'result') {
      if (currentAllRaceClicked == true) {
        return url + '?all=1';
      } else {
        return url;
      }
    } else if (mainMenuKeyList[currentMainMenu] == 'jushou') {
      return url;
    }
  }
  /**

   * @returns {boolean}

  function renderCommon() {
    // パンくず、タイトル表示
    var title = lastNightFlg && currentMainMenu === mainMenuCodeList.program ? '前夜版出走表' : '出走表・オッズ・レース結果';
    $('.breadCrumb').find('li:nth-child(3) > a').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[currentPlace] + 'オート').attr('href', '/race_info/Live/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeKeyList[currentPlace]);
    $('.breadCrumb').find('li:nth-child(4) > span').text(title);
    $('.searchTtl').text(title); // 開催場ハイライト

    $('li.netStadiumMenu__item').removeClass('netStadiumMenu__item--selected');
    $('li[data-circuit="' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeKeyList[currentPlace] + '"]').addClass('netStadiumMenu__item--selected');

      // 前夜版出走表はメインメニュー非表示

      $('#live-odds-rt3-container div.live-odds-rt3-tables').hide();
      $('#live-odds-rt3-container div.live-odds-rt3-tables[data-odds-rt3-tables-axis="' + currentOddsRt3Axis + '"]').show(); // 3連複軸

      $('#live-odds-rf3-container li.live-mainTab03__item').removeClass('live-mainTab03__item--current');
      $('#live-odds-rf3-container li[data-odds-rt3-axis="' + currentOddsRf3Axis + '"]').addClass('live-mainTab03__item--current');

      $('#live-odds-rf3-container div.live-odds-rt3-tables[data-odds-rt3-tables-axis="' + currentOddsRf3Axis + '"]').show();

  /**
   * レース情報の表示
   *
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderRaceInfo() {
    var refundFlg = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : false;
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': currentRaceno
    };
    var url = '/race_info/OtherRaceInfo';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      // console.log(orgRes)
      var res = orgRes.data.body;
      renderRaceInfoByRes(res, refundFlg);
      _function__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__["default"].showRaceLink(res.finalRaceNo);
    })["catch"](function (error) {
      if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
        // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
        tokenErrorCount++;
        setTimeout(function () {
          renderRaceInfo(refundFlg, tokenErrorCount);
        }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.interval);
      } else {
        // 予期せぬエラー
        console.log(error); // 天候、気温、湿度、走路温度をマスク

        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) > tbody > td:nth-child(4)').text('-');
        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) > tbody > td:nth-child(1)').text('-');
        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) > tbody > td:nth-child(2)').text('-');
        $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) > tbody > td:nth-child(3)').text('-');
        renderCommon();
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * レース情報の表示(APIリクエストなし)
   *
   * @param {object} res レース結果APIレスポンスBODY
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderRaceInfoByRes(res, refundFlg) {
    $('#race-result-race-info > h3').text(res.title);
    $('#race-result-race-info > span:nth-child(2)').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].gradeNameList[res.gradeCode]);
    $('#race-result-race-info > span:nth-child(3)').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameList[res.placeCode]);

    if (res.periodStartDate && res.periodEndDate) {
      var startDate = new Date(res.periodStartDate);
      var endDate = new Date(res.periodEndDate);
      var dateStr = startDate.getFullYear() + '年' + (startDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + startDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[startDate.getDay()] + ')～';

      if (startDate.getFullYear() !== endDate.getFullYear()) {
        // 年またぎ
        dateStr = dateStr + endDate.getFullYear() + '年' + (endDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      } else if (startDate.getMonth() !== endDate.getMonth()) {
        // 月またぎ
        dateStr = dateStr + (endDate.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      } else {
        dateStr = dateStr + endDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[endDate.getDay()] + ')';
      }

      var raceResultPeriod = $($('#template_race-result-race-period-time').clone().html());
      raceResultPeriod.children('div:nth-child(1)').children('span').text(res.raceName);
      raceResultPeriod.children('div:nth-child(1)').append('開催期間：' + dateStr + '　開催 第' + res.paragraphday + '日目');
      $('#race-result-race-period-time').html(raceResultPeriod.find('div'));
      var telvote = '<span class="mx-3">投票締切</span><br class="d-md-none">' + (res.telvoteTime || '');
      var raceStart = '<span class="mx-3">発走予定</span><br class="d-md-none">' + (res.raceStartTime || '');
      var changeItem = '<span class="text-red">[変更]</span>'; // 締切時刻変更

      if (res.changeInetFlg) {
        telvote += changeItem;
      } // 発走時刻変更


      if (res.changeStartFlg) {
        raceStart += changeItem;
      }

      $('#race-result-current-race-telvote').html(telvote);
      $('#race-result-current-race-start').html(raceStart); // ◯日目タブ表示

      var periodStartDate = new Date(res.periodStartDate);
      var periodEndDate = new Date(res.periodEndDate);
      var termDay = (periodEndDate - periodStartDate) / 86400000 + 1;
      var periodDateTabs = $('<div></div>');

      for (var i = 0; i < termDay; i++) {
        // 未来日の◯日目タブは表示しない
        if (nowDate.getTime() < periodStartDate.getTime()) {
          continue;
        }

        var paragraphdayRow = $($('#template_race-result-paragraphday-row').clone().html());
        var dayNumStr = i + 1 + '日目';

        if (i === 0) {
          dayNumStr = '初日';
        }

        paragraphdayRow.children('a').text(dayNumStr);
        paragraphdayRow.attr('data-period-date', generateReqDate(periodStartDate));
        periodDateTabs.append(paragraphdayRow.clone());
        periodStartDate.setDate(periodStartDate.getDate() + 1);
      }

      $('#live-paragraphday-main').html(periodDateTabs.clone().html()); // リクエストが終わるまでハイライトなしの状態になってしまうため、ここで一旦ハイライトする。

      $('li[data-period-date="' + generateReqDate(currentDate) + '"]').addClass('liveTabMenu__item--current');
    } // 初期値はレース結果天候情報


    var weather = res.raceWeather;
    var temp = res.raceTemp;
    var humid = res.raceHumid;
    var roadtemp = res.raceRoadtemp;
    var situationCode = res.raceSituationCode; // レース結果タブの天候表示遷移
    // 0. 確定までお待ち下さい：現在の天候情報を表示
    // 1. 払戻金 & 3着まで確定：非表示
    // 2. グランドノート確定　：非表示
    // 3. 全着順確定　　　　　：レース結果天候情報を表示
    // 現在のページが「レース結果」以外 or 現在のページが「レース結果」で払戻が確定していない
    // ※払戻金が確定して以下if文に入らなくなるとレース結果天候情報を使おうとする。
    //   しかし、全着順が確定するまではレース結果天候情報にデータが入らないため、2. の状態までは天候欄は非表示となる。

    if (currentMainMenu != mainMenuCodeList.result || currentMainMenu != mainMenuCodeList.jushou || (currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.result || currentMainMenu == mainMenuCodeList.jushou) && refundFlg == false) {
      // 当日の開催中レースの場合は現在の天候情報を表示
      if (nowRaceNo == currentRaceno && currentDate.getTime() == nowDate.getTime()) {
        // TODO 最終レース天候反映暫定対応
        if (weather === null) {
          weather = res.weather;
        }

        if (temp === null) {
          temp = res.temp;
        }

        if (humid === null) {
          humid = res.humid;
        }

        if (roadtemp === null) {
          roadtemp = res.roadtemp;
        }

        if (situationCode === null) {
          situationCode = res.situationCode;
        }
      } // 開催中の前のレースでレース結果が確定していない場合は現在の天候情報を表示


      if (nowRaceNo - 1 == currentRaceno && currentDate.getTime() == nowDate.getTime()) {
        if (weather === null) {
          weather = res.weather;
        }

        if (temp === null) {
          temp = res.temp;
        }

        if (humid === null) {
          humid = res.humid;
        }

        if (roadtemp === null) {
          roadtemp = res.roadtemp;
        }

        if (situationCode === null) {
          situationCode = res.situationCode;
        }
      }
    }

    var thisDate = new Date(currentDate);
    var thisDateStr = thisDate.getMonth() + 1 + '月' + thisDate.getDate() + '日(' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].weekDayName[thisDate.getDay()] + ')';
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(1)').text(thisDateStr);
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(2)').text((_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].raceClassNameList[res.classCode] || '') + (currentRaceno || '') + 'R');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(3)').text((res.distance || '') + 'm');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(4)').text(weather || '');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(1)').text((temp || '') + '℃');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(2)').text((humid || '') + '%');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(3)').text((roadtemp || '') + '℃');
    $('#race-result-race-info > div > table:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(4)').text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].situationNameList[situationCode] || '');
  }
  /**
   * 出走表の表示
   *
   * @param {object} res 出走表APIレスポンスBODY
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderProgram(res) {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
    $('#live-program > ul > li').show(); // 同時進行でレース情報更新

    renderRaceInfo();

    if (res) {
      renderProgramByRes(res);
    } else {
      var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
      var params = {
        'placeCode': currentPlace,
        'raceDate': reqDate,
        'raceNo': currentRaceno
      };
      var url = '/race_info/Program';
      var options = {
        timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
      };
      axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
        if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure' && orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
          displayCancelMain = true;
          renderCommon();
        } else {
          var _res = orgRes.data.body;
          renderProgramByRes(_res);
        }
      })["catch"](function (error) {
        if (error.response.status == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.status && tokenErrorCount < _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.retry) {
          // トークン不一致の場合は、2回までリトライ
          tokenErrorCount++;
          setTimeout(function () {
            renderProgram(null, tokenErrorCount);
          }, _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].tokenError.interval);
        } else {
          // 予期せぬエラー
          console.log(error);
          $('#live-program > ul > li').hide();
          $('#live-program > div.live-program-submenu-container').text('出走表の取得に失敗しました。');
          renderCommon();
        }
      });
    }
  }

      resultVod.find('.live-result-vod-race').attr('data-vod-link', replayUrl + '/0/1');
      resultVod.find('.live-result-recent').attr('href', '/race_info/Recent/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeKeyList[currentPlace]);
      $('#live-program-result-vod').html(resultVod);
    }

    renderCommon();
  }

      programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(5)').text(p.raceDev);
      programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(6)').children('span:nth-child(1)').html('2連率<br>' + p.rate2);
      programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(6)').children('span:nth-child(2)').html('3連率<br>' + p.rate3); // 近3走

      for (var i = 0; i < res.latest3List[p.playerCode].length; i++) {
        var thisRace = res.latest3List[p.playerCode][i];
        var orderTime = generateRecentOrderTime(thisRace);

        if (thisRace.situationCode == 0) {
          programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(' + (i + 7) + ')').addClass('bg-light-orange');
        } else if (thisRace.situationCode == 1) {
          programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(' + (i + 7) + ')').addClass('bg-light-blue');
        }

        programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(' + (i + 7) + ')').children('a').attr('href', '/race_info/RaceResult/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[thisRace.placeCode] + '/' + thisRace.raceDate + '_' + thisRace.raceNo).html(thisRace.raceDate.replace(/\-/g, '/').slice(-5) + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameShortList[thisRace.placeCode] + '<br>' + orderTime.order + thisRace.raceNo + 'R<br>' + (thisRace.startedCode == 1 ? '<font color="red">F</font> ' : '') + orderTime.time + '<br>' + (thisRace.trialRetryCode == 1 ? '再' : '') + (orderTime.order != '中止' ? thisRace.trialTime : '-') + '<br>' + (thisRace.stTime ? 'ST ' + thisRace.stTime : '-'));
      } // 湿前走


      var thisRaceList = res.latest5WetTrackList[p.playerCode].raceList;

      if (thisRaceList) {
        if (thisRaceList.length > 0) {
          if (thisRaceList[0].situationCode == 0) {
            programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(10)').addClass('bg-light-orange');
          } else if (thisRaceList[0].situationCode == 1) {
            programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(10)').addClass('bg-light-blue');
          }

          var _orderTime = generateRecentOrderTime(thisRaceList[0]);

          programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(10)').children('a').attr('href', '/race_info/RaceResult/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[thisRaceList[0].placeCode] + '/' + thisRaceList[0].raceDate + '_' + thisRaceList[0].raceNo).html(thisRaceList[0].raceDate.replace(/\-/g, '/').slice(-5) + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeNameShortList[thisRaceList[0].placeCode] + '<br>' + _orderTime.order + thisRaceList[0].raceNo + 'R<br>' + (thisRaceList[0].startedCode == 1 ? '<font color="red">F</font> ' : '') + _orderTime.time + '<br>' + (thisRaceList[0].trialRetryCode == 1 ? '再' : '') + thisRaceList[0].trialTime + '<br>' + (thisRaceList[0].stTime ? 'ST ' + thisRaceList[0].stTime : '-'));
        }
      } // 早見


      if (p.anotherRaceNo) {
        programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(11)').children('a').attr('data-raceno', p.anotherRaceNo).text(p.anotherRaceNo + 'R');
      }

      if (p.anotherRaceNo2) {
        var hayamiPlaceCode;

        if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi) {
          hayamiPlaceCode = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2;
        }

        if (currentPlace == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi2) {
          hayamiPlaceCode = _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeCodeList.kawaguchi;
        }

        programProgramTableRow.children('td:nth-child(11)').children('a').attr({
          'data-raceno': p.anotherRaceNo2,
          'data-hayamiPlaceNo': hayamiPlaceCode
        }).text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].hayamiCount[hayamiPlaceCode] + '回目' + p.anotherRaceNo2 + 'R');
      }

      programProgramTable.find('tbody').append(programProgramTableRow);
    });
    $('#live-program-program-container').html(programProgramTable);
  }

  /**
   * オッズの表示
   *
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderOdds() {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : 0;
    // 同時進行でレース情報更新
    renderRaceInfo();
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate,
      'raceNo': currentRaceno
    };
    var allPlayerNumberList = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]; // APIリクエスト

    var url = '/race_info/Odds';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      $('#live-odds > ul > li').show(); // console.log(orgRes)

      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
        if (orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
          displayCancelMain = true;
        }

        renderCommon();
        return;
      }

      var expectedTable;
      var res = orgRes.data.body;
      var aiPredictionsExplanation = $($('#template_ai-predictions-explanation').clone().html()); // オートレースモバイル廃止日以前

      if (currentDate.getTime() < new Date(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].mobileAbolitionDate).getTime()) {
        // 予想表作成 旧レイアウト
        expectedTable = createExpectedTableOld(res); // 晴雨テキストAI文字を削除

        aiPredictionsExplanation.filter('div').eq(0).html(aiPredictionsExplanation.filter('div').eq(0).html().replace('AI', ''));
      } else {
        // 予想表作成 新レイアウト
        expectedTable = createExpectedTable(res);
      } // モーダルにAI予想についての説明追加


      $('#exampleModalCenter').children('div').children('div').children('div:nth-child(2)').html(aiPredictionsExplanation); // オッズ情報がない

      if (res.rtwOddsList.length == 0) {
        $('#live-odds > ul > li').hide();
        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').html(expectedTable.clone()); // 「AI予想とは」表示

        var _oddsUpdateTime = $($('#template_odds-update-time').clone().html());

        _oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').hide();

        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').append(_oddsUpdateTime);
        $('#live-odds > div.live-odds-submenu-container').append('オッズの表示までしばらくお待ち下さい。');
        renderCommon();
        return;
      }

      var voteDivNum = 4; // 予想ブロック雛形作成

      var expectedBlock; // オートレースモバイル廃止日以前

      if (currentDate.getTime() < new Date(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].mobileAbolitionDate).getTime()) {
        // 予想ブロック雛形作成 旧レイアウト
        expectedBlock = createExpectedBlockOld(res);
        voteDivNum = 5;
      } else {
        // 予想ブロック雛形作成 新レイアウト
        expectedBlock = createExpectedBlock(res);
      } // レース結果VOD作成


      var resultVod = $($('#template_live-result-result-vod').clone().html());
      var replayUrl = '/race_info/Ondemand/asx/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].subPlaceKeyList[currentPlace] + '/' + generateReqDate(currentDate) + '_' + currentRaceno;
      resultVod.find('.live-result-vod-trial').attr('data-vod-link', replayUrl + '/1/1');
      resultVod.find('.live-result-vod-race').attr('data-vod-link', replayUrl + '/0/1');
      resultVod.find('.live-result-recent').attr('href', '/race_info/Recent/' + _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].placeKeyList[currentPlace]); // 2/3連単表作成

      var oddsRt23 = $('<div></div>');
      var oddsRt23List = $($('#template_live-odds-player-list-rt23').clone().html());
      var updateDate = new Date(res.salesInfo.updateDate.replace(/\-/g, '/'));
      var updateHour = ('0' + updateDate.getHours()).slice(-2);
      var updateMinutes = ('0' + updateDate.getMinutes()).slice(-2); // オッズ更新時刻・オッズ確定配置

      var oddsUpdateTime = $($('#template_odds-update-time').clone().html());

      if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['undeterminedOdds']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').text('オッズ更新 ' + updateHour + ':' + updateMinutes);
      } else if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['determinedOdds']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').addClass('border-danger text-danger').text('オッズ確定');
      } else if (res.statusCode === _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCode['oddsUpdateError']) {
        oddsUpdateTime.find('#updated_odds_time_display').addClass('border-warning bg-light-orange').text('オッズ更新エラー');
      }

      oddsRt23.append(oddsUpdateTime);
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var p = pNumIndex < res.playerList.length ? res.playerList[pNumIndex] : null;
        var playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
        playerNumberList.splice(playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1); // console.log(playerNumberList)

        var playerRt23 = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23').clone().html());
        var rt2OddsList = res.rtwOddsList;
        var rt3OddsList = res.rt3OddsList; // 表1行目

        var playerRt23Row1st = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-1st').clone().html());
        playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(1)').text(pNum).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));
        if (p) playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(2)').children('p').text(p.playerName);
        playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(2)').addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + pNum).slice(-2));

        for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
          // 車番
          playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(' + ((i + 1) * 2 + 1) + ')').text(playerNumberList[i]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[i]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

          var thisOdds = p && i < res.playerList.length - 1 ? rt2OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[i]] : '';
          var thisClass = generateOddsClass(thisOdds);
          playerRt23Row1st.children('td:nth-child(' + ((i + 1) * 2 + 2) + ')').text(thisOdds).addClass(thisClass);
        }

        playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row1st); // 表2行目

        var playerRt23Row2nd = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-2nd').clone().html());

        for (var _i = 0; _i < 7; _i++) {
          var playerNumberList2 = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
          playerNumberList2.splice(playerNumberList2.indexOf(pNum), 1);
          playerNumberList2.splice(playerNumberList2.indexOf(playerNumberList[_i]), 1); // 車番

          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 1) + ')').text(playerNumberList[_i]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[_i]).slice(-2));
          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 2) + ')').text(playerNumberList2[0]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[_i]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

          var _thisOdds = p && _i < res.playerList.length - 1 ? rt3OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[_i]][playerNumberList2[0]] : '';

          var _thisClass = generateOddsClass(_thisOdds);

          playerRt23Row2nd.children('td:nth-child(' + (_i * 3 + 3) + ')').text(_thisOdds).addClass(_thisClass);
        }

        playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row2nd); // 表3～7行目

        for (var _i2 = 0; _i2 < 5; _i2++) {
          var playerRt23Row3rd = $($('#template_live-odds-player-rt23-row-3rd-or-later').clone().html());

          for (var j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            var _playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();

            _playerNumberList.splice(_playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1);

            _playerNumberList.splice(_playerNumberList.indexOf(playerNumberList[j]), 1); // 車番


            playerRt23Row3rd.children('td:nth-child(' + (j * 2 + 1) + ')').text(_playerNumberList[_i2 + 1]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + playerNumberList[j]).slice(-2)); // オッズ

            var _thisOdds2 = p && j < res.playerList.length - 1 && _i2 + 1 < res.playerList.length - 2 ? rt3OddsList[p.carNo][playerNumberList[j]][_playerNumberList[_i2 + 1]] : '';

            var _thisClass2 = generateOddsClass(_thisOdds2);

            playerRt23Row3rd.children('td:nth-child(' + (j * 2 + 2) + ')').text(_thisOdds2).addClass(_thisClass2);
          }

          playerRt23.children('tbody').append(playerRt23Row3rd);
        }

        oddsRt23List.children('div').children('div').append(playerRt23);
      });
      oddsRt23.append(oddsRt23List.html());
      $('#live-odds-rt23-container').html(oddsRt23.html()); // 3連単表作成

      var rt3PlayerNumberList = {};
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var playerNumberList = allPlayerNumberList.concat();
        playerNumberList.splice(playerNumberList.indexOf(pNum), 1);
        rt3PlayerNumberList[pNum] = playerNumberList;
      }); // console.log(rt3PlayerNumberList)

      var oddsRt3 = $('<div></div>'); // レース結果VOD作成

      oddsRt3.append(resultVod); // オッズ更新時刻・オッズ確定配置

      oddsRt3.append(oddsUpdateTime);
      var oddsRt3Axis = $($('#template_live-odds-rt3-axis-link').clone().html());
      oddsRt3.append(oddsRt3Axis);
      allPlayerNumberList.forEach(function (pNum, pNumIndex) {
        var p = pNumIndex < res.playerList.length ? res.playerList[pNumIndex] : null; // 雛形(2テーブル)に車番号など適用

        var oddsRt3Tables = $($('#template_live-odds-rt3-tables').clone().html());
        oddsRt3Tables.attr('data-odds-rt3-tables-axis', pNum);
        var playerNameContainer = p ? $('<p></p>').text(p.carNo + ' ' + p.playerName) : '';

  /**
   * 「重勝式・経過結果」タブの表示
   * 
   * @returns {Promise}
   */


  function changeDisplayJushou() {
    // 重勝情報APIリクエスト
    var jushoApiUrl = '/race_info/JushouEvent';
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var jushoApiparams = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate
    };
    var jushoApioptions = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    displayJushou = true;
    return axios.post(jushoApiUrl, jushoApiparams, jushoApioptions).then(function (jushouApiRes) {
      // 重勝式の情報がない場合はタブを非表示
      if (jushouApiRes.data.result == 'Failure' && jushouApiRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == '4101') {
        displayJushou = false;
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * 重勝式経過結果の表示
   *
   * @param {int} tokenErrorCount トークンエラー回数
   * @returns {boolean}
   */


  function renderJushouResult() {
    var tokenErrorCount = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : 0;
    // 同時進行でレース情報更新
    renderRaceInfo();
    var reqDate = generateReqDate(currentDate);
    var params = {
      'placeCode': currentPlace,
      'raceDate': reqDate
    }; // APIリクエスト

    var url = '/race_info/JushouEvent';
    var options = {
      timeout: _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].apiTimeout
    };
    axios.post(url, params, options).then(function (orgRes) {
      // console.log(orgRes)
      if (orgRes.data.result == 'Failure') {
        if (orgRes.data.errors[0]['code'] == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].statusCodeList['cancel']) {
          displayCancelMain = true;
        } else {
          // 重勝式経過結果がない
          $('#jushou-result-tables').text('重勝式の表示までしばらくお待ち下さい。');
        }

        renderCommon();
        return;
      }

      var res = orgRes.data.body;
      var jushouContainer = $('<div></div>'); // 車番号バッジ雛形

      var refundmentBadge = $($('#template_live-result-refundment-badge').clone().html()); // 車番号マーク雛形

      var refundmentMark = $($('#template_live-result-refundment-mark').clone().html()); // 重勝式経過結果表作成

      jushouContainer.append('<h3 class="m-3 font-weight-bold">経過結果</h3>');
      $.each(res, function (type, typeInfo) {
        var jushouTable;

        if (type == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].jushouTypeList['TWO']) {
          // TWOのテンプレート
          jushouTable = $($('#template_jushou-two-table').clone().html());
          typeInfo.forEach(function (twoData) {
            twoData.resultList.forEach(function (result) {
              var resultTable = $($('#template_jushou-two-result-table').clone().html());

              for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                resultTable.children().eq(i + 1).text(twoData.startRaceNum + i + 'R');
              }

              resultTable.children().eq(4).text(twoData.salesVotes.toLocaleString() + '票');

              if (result.refundList.length !== 0 && result.refundList.refundType == 4) {
                // 無投票
                resultTable.children().eq(12).text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].jushouRefundTypeList[result.refundList.refundType]);
              } else if (result.refundList.length !== 0 && (result.refundList.refundType == 1 || result.refundList.refundType == 3)) {
                // 特払い、全返還
                resultTable.children().eq(12).text(_config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].jushouRefundTypeList[result.refundList.refundType] + ' ' + result.refundList.amount.toLocaleString() + '円');
              } else if (result.refundList.length !== 0) {
                resultTable.children().eq(12).text(result.refundList.amount.toLocaleString() + '円');
              }

              result.raceList.forEach(function (race, rIndex) {
                if (race.atarime[0] == 0) {
                  // 不成立表示
                  resultTable.children().eq(rIndex + 6).text('不成立').removeClass('small');
                } else {
                  resultTable.children().eq(rIndex + 6).html(refundmentBadge.clone().text(race.atarime[0]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + race.atarime[0]).slice(-2))).append(refundmentMark.clone().text('=')).append(refundmentBadge.clone().text(race.atarime[1]).addClass('raceNum--' + ('0' + race.atarime[1]).slice(-2)));
                }

                if (race.hitPotentialVotes !== null) {
                  resultTable.children().eq(rIndex + 9).text(race.hitPotentialVotes.toLocaleString() + '票');
                }

                res.absentList.forEach(function (absentInfo) {
                  if (race.raceNum == absentInfo.raceNum) {
                    resultTable.children().eq(rIndex + 14).text(absentInfo.absent.join(','));
                  }
                });
              });
              jushouTable.find('tbody').append(resultTable);
            });

            if (twoData.resultList.length === 0) {
              var resultTable = $($('#template_jushou-two-result-table').clone().html());

              for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                resultTable.children().eq(i + 1).text(twoData.startRaceNum + i + 'R');
              }

              resultTable.children().eq(4).text(twoData.salesVotes.toLocaleString() + '票');
              jushouTable.find('tbody').append(resultTable);
            }
          });
        } else if (type == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].jushouTypeList['THREE'] || type == _config__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__["default"].jushouTypeList['FOUR']) {

  function generateReqDate(date) {

   * 日付文字列の妥当性チェック

  function checkDate(strDate) {
    if (strDate.match(/^\d{4}\-\d{2}\-\d{2}$/) == null) {
      return false;
    }

    var y = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[0]);
    var m = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[1]) - 1;
    var d = parseInt(strDate.split("-")[2]);
    var date = new Date(y, m, d);

    if (date.getFullYear() != y || date.getMonth() != m || date.getDate() != d) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

      return false;
    }

    return true;
  } // ブラウザバック用の履歴作成

    var prizeComment = '※' + year + 'の成績' + '<br>' + '※賞金データの集計タイミングにより誤差が生ずる場合があります。' + '<br>' + '※賞金には手当てなどが含まれています。' + '<br>' + '※同賞金の場合、ランクにより順位付け' + '<br>' + '※出走回数が０回の場合は表示しておりません。'; // 賞金ランキングコメント用格納jQueryオブジェクト

    var prizeCommentItem = $($('#template_raning_prize_comment').clone().html());
    prizeCommentItem.append(prizeComment);
    prizeCommentItem.addClass(addClass);
    prizeCommentContainer.append(prizeCommentItem);
    $('#ranking_main_area').append(prizeCommentContainer);
    return true;
  }

   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function appendMainNav(text) {
    var addClass = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : null;
    // 切り替えナビ格納jQueryオブジェクト
    var navItem = $($('#template_raning_main_nav_li').clone().html());

    if (addClass != null) {
      navItem.addClass(addClass);

    navArea.find('ul').append(navItem);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * ランキングテーブル作成共通処理
   *
   * @param {object} item テーブルボディ用jQueryオブジェクト
   * @param {object} data ランキングデータ
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function makeTableCommon(item, data) {
    // 3位のみクラス追加
    if (data.no === 3) {
      item.find('td').addClass('rankingTableCnt--3');
    } // 3位以内とそれ以外で順位表示を分ける


    if (data.no <= 3) {
      var top3Class = 'rankingTableCnt__rank--' + data.no;
      item.find('.rankingTableCnt__rank').addClass(top3Class).append($('<span></span>').text(data.no));
    } else {
      item.find('.rankingTableCnt__rank').text(data.no);
    }

    return true;
  }
  /**
   * 選手名表示とプロフィールページへのリンク作成
   *
   * @param {object} item テーブルボディ用jQueryオブジェクト
   * @param string playerCode 選手コード
   * @param string playerName 選手名
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function makeLinkProfile(item, playerCode, playerName) {
    item.find('.rankingTableCnt__profile').find('a').attr('href', '/race_info/Profile/' + playerCode).text(playerName);
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * トップページメインランキングテーブル作成
   *
   * @param array data ランキングの配列

   */


  function makeTopMainTable(data) {
    // ランキングテーブル格納jQueryオブジェクト

    var headerItem = $($('#template_raning_top_main_table_header').clone().html());

      var placeClass = 'bgcolor-' + d.placeKey; // ランキングテーブル作成共通処理

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * 賞金ランキングテーブル作成
   *
   * @param array data ランキングの配列
   * @returns {boolean} 成功/失敗
   */


  function makePrizeTable(data, addClass) {
    // 20位ごとの配列にする
    var dataList = divideArrIntoPieces(data, 20);
    dataList.forEach(function (list) {
      // 各テーブルの先頭順位
      var firstNo = list[0].no; // 各テーブルの末尾の順位

      var lastNo = list[list.length - 1].no; // テーブル切り替えナビ作成

      var text = firstNo + '~' + lastNo;
      appendMainNav(text, addClass); // ランキングテーブル格納jQueryオブジェクト

      var itemClone = rankingTableItem.clone();
      itemClone.addClass(addClass); // 賞金用ヘッダーjQueryオブジェクト

      var headerItem = $($('#template_raning_prize_table_header').clone().html());
      itemClone.find('thead').append(headerItem);
      list.forEach(function (d) {
        // 賞金用ボディjQueryオブジェクト
        var bodyItem = $($('#template_raning_prize_table_body').clone().html()); // 競技場別クラス名

        var placeClass = 'bgcolor-' + d.placeKey; // ランキングテーブル作成共通処理

        makeTableCommon(bodyItem, d); // 選手名表示とプロフィールページへのリンク作成

        makeLinkProfile(bodyItem, d.playerCode, d.playerName);
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_prize').text(d.prize + '円');
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_rank').text(d.currentRank);
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_run_count').text(d.runCount);
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_graduation').text(d.graduation + '期');
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_age').text(d.age);
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_place').addClass(placeClass).text(d.placeName);
        bodyItem.find('.ranking_prize_national_rank').text(d.nationalRank);
        itemClone.find('tbody').append(bodyItem);
      });
      $('#ranking_result_table').append(itemClone);
    });
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * 配列を指定数ごとに分けて多次元配列を返却
   *
   * @param array arr ランキングの配列
   * @param int n 分割数
   * @returns array dataList
   */


  function divideArrIntoPieces(arr, n) {
    var dataList = [];
    var idx = 0;

    while (idx < arr.length) {
      dataList.push(arr.splice(idx, idx + n));
    }

    return dataList;
  }
  /**
   * 日付のフォーマット
   *
   * @param string date 日付
   * @return {string}
   */


  function formatDate(date) {
    var dt = new Date(date);
    var year = dt.getFullYear() + '年';
    var month = dt.getMonth() + 1 + '月';
    var day = dt.getDate() + '日';
    return year + month + day;
  }
  /**
   * 年のフォーマット
   *

$('#test_page #search_player_result_btn').on('click', function () {
  // 通信先URL
  var url = '/race_info/SearchPlayerResult';
  var playerCode = $('input[name="player_result_player_code"]').val();
  var startDate = $('input[name="player_result_start_date"]').val();
  var endDate = $('input[name="player_result_end_date"]').val();
  var page = $('input[name="player_result_page"]').val();
  var placeCodeList = [];
  var gradeList = [];
  var handicapList = [];
  var raceClassList = [];
  var bikeClassList = [];
  var orderList = [];
  var holdTypeList = [];
  var openraceList = [];
  var situationList = [];
  var carNoList = [];
  $('.player_result_place:checked').map(function () {
    placeCodeList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_grade:checked').map(function () {
    gradeList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_handicap:checked').map(function () {
    handicapList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_race_class:checked').map(function () {
    raceClassList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_bike_class:checked').map(function () {
    bikeClassList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_order:checked').map(function () {
    orderList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_hold_type:checked').map(function () {
    holdTypeList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_openrace:checked').map(function () {
    openraceList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_situation:checked').map(function () {
    situationList.push($(this).val());
  });
  $('.player_result_car_no:checked').map(function () {
    carNoList.push($(this).val());
  }); // パラメータセット

  var params = {
    'playerCode': playerCode,
    'startDate': startDate,
    'endDate': endDate,
    'placeCodeList': placeCodeList,
    'gradeList': gradeList,
    'handicapList': handicapList,
    'raceClassList': raceClassList,
    'bikeClassList': bikeClassList,
    'orderList': orderList,
    'holdTypeList': holdTypeList,
    'openraceList': openraceList,
    'situationList': situationList,
    'carNoList': carNoList,
    'page': page
  }; // データを追加する要素取得

  var element = $('#search_player_result').find('.overflow-auto'); // データ取得

  axios.post(url, params).then(function (res) {
    putResponseData(element, res.data);
  })["catch"](function (error) {
    putErrorMessage(element, error);
  });
}); // 特別記念レース結果検索
